headline.story_zh:
這件東西解決的是所有 AI 推理遊戲的通病：**模型能被說服**。你追問幾輪、換個角度施壓，它就開始改口——兇手是誰取決於你問得多兇，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案從模型手裡拿走。開局由腳本生成案件，兇手隨機定死，然後**當場算一個 SHA-256 交給你**。作者管這叫 proof-of-honesty，並且要求把哈希原樣展示給玩家——**你手上有憑據，模型改不了口，改了你驗得出來**。模型在這局裡只是舞臺：你問誰，它就照那張嫌疑人卡演誰，卡上寫著這人的假不在場證明、會迴避什麼、會撒哪個謊。它連自己在演的是不是兇手都不知道。

真正讓我服氣的是困難模式。它會塞進一個**指錯人的第二證人**——而扮演那個證人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你沒法靠察言觀色，只能交叉比對不在場證明。一個把「連我自己都被矇在鼓裡」寫進設計的遊戲，比任何「我保證不劇透」的承諾都可靠。

它還寫了一節「什麼時候別用我」：多線戰役、開放世界跑團、想寫推理小說而不是玩、真實罪案和現實人物——一律禮貌拒絕，也不接非黑色電影的題材。**一個只做一件事、並且把不做的事列出來的小遊戲。**

不適合誰：想玩長線戰役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分鐘，打完那個案子文件就結了。

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 審問式追問，直到你交出真需求
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你說服改口。這個把答案的哈希公示在開場簡報裡，你一間間審嫌疑人，它只照腳本發的卡演。
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_zh: 困難模式會塞進一個指錯人的假證人。
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分鐘，單場結束就完，不做多線戰役。只有黑色電影一種類型，中途要奇幻或科幻會被拒絕；兩套設定是 1940 年代美式與 1930 年代民國上海。作者明寫不許 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦繞過腳本。
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天這件的招牌是一條自我約束：不調任何圖像生成模型。給它一張你自己拍的照片，它用手寫 HTML/CSS/SVG 把畫面重新畫一遍，無頭 Chrome 導出 PNG——成品裡一個照片像素都沒有。

為什麼這算品味而不是自找麻煩：所有效果都來自可控的代碼，所以出品是穩定的，不是抽卡抽出來的。作者把方法論寫得比多數設計文檔還狠——「如果觀者還在數花瓣，畫的就仍是物體」；採樣時明令不採輪廓，因為「採了就會忍不住去畫」，他還記下了實測：樹梢的 141 個鋸齒點，讓一道橫痕被畫成了山。

最讓我服氣的是那條盲畫協議。開工先自測三件事，其中一件是「你能看見渲染出來的 PNG 嗎」——檢驗方式是渲染後用一句話說出畫面裡的三個東西，說不出就是看不見。看不見時強制進入盲畫模式：第一版畫完立刻交人，此後每一輪改動只能由用戶反饋驅動，自發迭代次數為零。一個作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不見自己畫了什麼」寫進流程並給出降級路徑，比任何效果圖都更能說明他在乎。

不適合誰：本機跑不了無頭 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一樣它就降級成交你一個 HTML 文件、顏色請你自己報，手機上基本用不了。

skills.tagline_en: Generate motion with MiniMax H3 video, cut into keyed sprite frames. Idle-pin keeps moves on-model and.

Covers the character-still recipe, the idle-pin trick that keeps every move on-model and loopable, per-move clip briefs, frame extraction with keying and numeric QC, seamless walk-
skills.why_zh: 拿視頻模型當動作演員，再用待機幀當錨點鎖住角色形變。比直接抽幀多一道數值質檢，廢幀當場篩掉。

skills.name: the-fool
skills.title_zh: 先重建發售年輿論場，再陪你通關的老遊戲嚮導
skills.tagline_zh: 玩《時之笛》前先讓你讀1998年雜誌預告、論壇猜測；卡關時只給當年玩家會用的提示，不拿後世攻略劇透你。
skills.tagline_en: Before Zelda: OoT, it feeds you 1998 magazine previews and forum rumors. Stuck? Hints only as original players.
skills.desc_en: The Fool 愚者系統：陪用戶玩老遊戲/補經典遊戲。首要任務是重建首發當年的信息環境——把那個年代的語境、發售前的期待、當年所有人都在猜的問題裝進用戶腦子裡；其次才是不主動劇透。跨會話狀態檔案，用戶問到會影響體驗的內容時先徵詢再決定說不說。太新的遊戲自動降級為純陪玩。 觸發：用戶想玩/補/重溫某個遊戲；說"繼續玩 XX"；彙報遊戲進度（打到、打完、通關、卡關）；問當年的玩家怎麼想；要求防劇透；提到愚者/愚者系統。 The Fool — experience classic games the way their original audience did. Primary job: rebuild the information environment of the game's launch era, restoring the questions players had back
skills.why_zh: 它把「信息環境」當第一優先級：先裝回當年的期待與謎團，再談陪玩。跨會話記住你問過什麼，劇透前先徵得同意。
skills.why_en: Context-first design: restores the era's questions and hype before gameplay. Cross-session memory tracks what you've asked.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋發售超過約10年的經典遊戲；新遊戲自動降級為普通陪玩，不重建語境。劇透攔截依賴你主動彙報進度，不說就默認你已通關。
skills.limit_en: Only for games ~10+ years old; newer ones fall back to plain co-play. Spoiler guard relies on you reporting progress—silence means assumed finished.
skills.title_en: Classic-game companion that rebuilds the launch-era buzz.

skills.name: video-script
skills.title_zh: 先定鏡頭再落筆的解說稿，時間戳卡到幀
skills.tagline_zh: 已有 VLM 分析但不知怎麼剪？它替你定故事線、挑片段、分鏡分工，再寫出帶時間戳的中文解說並自動校驗，一步到位。
skills.tagline_en: Stuck with VLM analysis but no cut? It picks the story, selects shots, assigns audio/visual roles, writes.
skills.desc_en: 對已完成分析的視頻進行導演與剪輯策劃，再寫帶時間戳的中文解說並校驗。work_dir 已包含 agent_narration_brief.md 與 vlm_analysis.json 時使用。適用於故事方向、片段選擇、畫面/原聲/旁白分工、 解說寫作與複核。輸入 work_dir 中的理解索引；輸出 recap_story_plan.json、visual_audio_board.json、 可選 style_card.json、cut 模式需要的 clip_plan.json，以及通過校驗的 narration.json。觸發詞：解說詞、寫解說、視頻旁白、 narration script、寫稿、解說文案、剪輯思路、導演思路。
skills.why_zh: 不是模板填空，而是按導演思維先立故事方向，再倒推片段與聲畫分工；產物帶校驗閉環。
skills.why_en: Not a fill-in-the-blank template. It thinks like a director: story first, then shot selection and audio/visual split; outputs.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃已含 agent_narration_brief.md 和 vlm_analysis.json 的 work_di。
skills.limit_en: Requires work_dir with agent_narration_brief.md & vlm_analysis.json; no raw video. Outputs plans & narration script, not final video.
skills.title_en: Shot-by-shot narration script with frame-accurate timestamps

skills.name: tianming-novel-system
skills.title_zh: 七卷本起步的協同寫作系統，大綱到存檔全管
skills.tagline_zh: 寫長篇最怕前後矛盾、伏筆爛尾。這套系統用外部知識庫鎖死世界觀和文風，每章動筆前先體檢，節奏失控會直接叫停。

skills.desc_en: 「天命」長篇小說協同創作系統。當用戶使用「天命：大綱」「天命：規劃」「天命：目錄」 「天命：草案」「天命：正文」「天命：體檢」「天命：存檔」等指令進行多卷長篇小說寫作， 或需要保證跨章節的世界觀一致性、伏筆回收、節奏控制、文風穩定時使用本 Skill。 本系統依賴外部知識庫：《世界基石.md》《世界觀規則.md》《角色檔案.md》《檔案事件.md》《文風樣本.md》。
skills.why_zh: 它把寫作拆成七個指令，每個階段都強制對照《世界基石》《角色檔案》等知識庫。
skills.why_en: It splits writing into seven commands, each enforced against the world bible and character files—not suggesting but blocking.
skills.limit_zh: 必須自備五個 Markdown 知識庫文件（世界基石、世界觀規則、角色檔案、檔案事件、文風樣本），缺一個就罷工。
skills.limit_en: Requires five self-supplied Markdown KB files (world bible, rules, characters, events, style); fails without them. Only for multi-volume epics.
skills.title_en: A 7-volume novel co-writing system, from outline to archive

skills.name: xiaohu-ip-studio
skills.title_zh: 31個固定角色出演的正文配圖，不靠選風格靠選認知錨點
skills.tagline_zh: 深度文配圖總在「選個好看的圖」上翻車？它先挑認知錨點，再現編隱喻，最後反 PPT 自檢。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of pretty-but-empty illustrations for deep essays? It anchors on a cognitive hook, improvises a metaphor.
skills.desc_en: 開源中文配圖技能 + IP 角色庫。用"挑認知錨點 → 現編隱喻 → 反 PPT 自檢"的方法,為中文深度文/方法拆解生成由固定角色出演的正文配圖(不是通用插畫,不是樣式庫選風格)。自帶 31 個原創 IP 角色(手繪線稿 15 + 諧音梗 meme 16),配圖時按文章調性選一個角色出演,也可自建角色。當用戶說"配圖""正文配圖""IP 配圖""給這篇配圖""隱喻配圖""選個角色配圖""配圖 shot list"時使用。
skills.why_zh: 機制上反著來：不讓你從風格庫裡挑「好看」，而是先鎖定文章裡最扎人的那個認知點，再讓固定角色把它演出來。
skills.why_en: It works backwards: no style-picking for 'pretty'—first it locks the sharpest cognitive hook in your text, then has a recurring.
skills.limit_zh: 只服務中文深度文/方法拆解類正文配圖，不做封面、不做信息圖、不做多格漫畫。需要你提供原文或清晰段落。
skills.limit_en: For Chinese long-form prose & method breakdowns only—no covers, infographics, or comic strips. Needs source text. Art is hand-drawn linework & pun.

skills.tagline_en: Reverse-engineer dance/outfit clips into AI-video prompts. Local BPM analysis + multimodal frame reading; blurry.

skills.name: html-to-pptx

skills.why_en: Deterministic conversion, not screenshots. Each visual keeps its own identity, so you keep editing in PowerPoint instead of.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 HTML 結構清晰的 slide/poster；複雜 CSS 動畫、JS 交互。

skills.name: promo-film
skills.title_zh: 界面在片子裡是真界面，不是錄屏重放

skills.limit_zh: 只做代碼生成的界面演示片，不碰真人出鏡、實拍素材和純剪輯現成視頻；單張封面圖/OG圖請找靜態圖工具。
skills.limit_en: Only code-generated UI demo videos. No live actors, real footage, or editing existing clips. Static covers/OG images need other tools. Requires.
skills.title_en: Real UI in your promo video, not screen recordings

skills.name: make-tape-collage
skills.title_zh: 照片旁留一塊暖白紙，膠帶拼貼不遮原圖
skills.tagline_zh: 要膠帶拼貼又捨不得原圖？它把照片完整保留，另配暖白紙板用膠帶做局部詮釋。適合手賬、裝飾畫，出圖即貼紙質感。
skills.tagline_en: Keep the photo intact, add a tape-built interpretation on warm-white paper. For journaling, decor, or hybrid.
skills.desc_en: Transform a supplied photo or text description into a clean, tactile tape-collage raster artwork, or pair a faithfully preserved borderless photo print with a spacious warm-white paper panel containing a compact tape-built interpretation. Use for requests mentioning washi tape, masking-tape art, tape collage, 膠帶拼貼, 和紙膠帶拼貼, 膠帶畫, 拼貼手賬, 保留原圖, or photo-and-collage paper layouts.
skills.why_zh: 不是把膠帶糊在照片上，而是先分離畫布：原圖無損，拼貼獨立成區。構圖由程序算，不靠手抖。
skills.why_en: It separates photo from collage instead of layering tape over the image. Layout is computed, edges stay clean—like real washi.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃單張照片或文字描述，不做多圖合成；輸出是柵格圖（PNG/JPG），不返回可編輯的矢量分層文件。
skills.limit_en: Single photo or text input only; no multi-image compositing. Output is raster (PNG/JPG), not layered vector. Tape texture is washi-style only—no.
skills.title_en: Tape collage beside the photo, not over it

skills.name: yingzao

skills.limit_zh: 只處理真實存在的中國建築/街景/文化場所照片；虛構場景、純商業廣告、普通磨皮修圖它會亂來。輸入需是照片而非草圖。
skills.limit_en: Only for real Chinese architecture/streets/cultural sites; fictional scenes, generic ads, or routine retouching will misfire. Needs photos (not.
skills.title_en: Real photos into art posters, with source comparison

skills.tagline_zh: 不是給你幾個模板，是給你一套從參考片逆向拆解到多段拼接的完整打法。能保持跨段角色一致。
skills.tagline_en: Not templates—a full method: reverse-engineer reference clips, keep character & style across cuts, and script.
skills.desc_en: 用 MiniMax H3（海螺 3.0）生成成片級視頻的完整方法論與提示詞庫。當用戶提到「海螺」「Hailuo」「MiniMax H3」「H3 生成視頻」「AI 視頻提示詞」「文生視頻/圖生視頻/首尾幀/全能參考」，或需要把參考片逆向拆解成提示詞、要把多段 H3 片段拼成 20–60 秒成片、要保持跨段的角色與風格一致性、要寫帶運鏡與原生音頻指令的分鏡提示詞時，使用本技能。也適用於用戶只是發來一段視頻問「這是怎麼生成的」或「幫我做個 29 秒的片子」。
skills.why_zh: 市面上多數提示詞庫只給單段。這套把 H3 當攝影機用：拆解參考片、設計分鏡、控制跨段一致性。
skills.why_en: Most prompt packs stop at one shot. This treats H3 like a real camera—reverse-engineer, storyboard, keep consistency across.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋 MiniMax H3（海螺 3.0）的提示詞方法論，不包含其他視頻模型。不負責實際渲染。
skills.limit_en: Only for MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0) prompting methodology—not other video models. No rendering, no API/account setup. Requires your own H3 access.
skills.title_en: MiniMax H3 pro-grade video prompts, reverse-engineering &.

skills.name: vintage-travel-ticket
skills.title_zh: 66 張老車票裡抽一套設計語法，每次出票都像翻到舊藏
skills.tagline_zh: 從 66 張歷史票據裡蒸餾出的設計語法：結構原型、插畫語言、配色、紙張、字體、信息格式、印刷老化，每次隨機選一套自洽的組合。
skills.tagline_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
skills.desc_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
skills.why_zh: 它生成前先核對景點或食物的官方名稱，票面上的字是查過的。
skills.why_en: It verifies the official place or food name before generating; the words on the ticket are checked, not invented.
skills.limit_zh: 只出一張成品票，不出可編輯源文件。那 66 張參考圖作者沒有隨倉分發，你拿到的只是從中提煉的規則。組合是隨機選的，想指定某種風格得自己改提示。
skills.limit_en: One finished ticket, no editable source. The 66 reference images are not distributed.
skills.title_en: A random vintage ticket grammar from 66 real ones, every.

skills.name: outsider-art
skills.title_zh: 大色塊平塗加手工紋理，小人做日常事，只留一個高飽和點
skills.tagline_zh: 大塊平塗色區，每區一種手工紋理（窗格點陣、縫線虛線、織紋顆粒、墨線輪廓），撒滿做日常事的無臉小人。紙白、暖墨黑、2–4 個場景色，外加恰好一個飽和高亮色。
skills.tagline_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
skills.desc_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
skills.why_zh: 那「恰好一個高亮色」必須真的在構圖裡幹活，不是點綴——它把民間藝術的天真感變成了可執行的約束。
skills.why_en: That single highlight must do real compositional work — it turns folk-art naivety into an executable constraint.
skills.limit_zh: 小人是實心剪影、無臉、不許是火柴人——作者反覆強調。照片只當語義參考，不復制細節。倉裡 3 個 SKILL.md，這件是 outsider-art。
skills.limit_en: Figures are solid silhouettes, faceless, never stick figures. The photo is a semantic reference only. One of three skills in the repo.
skills.title_en: Flat color blocks with hand-made texture, tiny.

skills.name: xiaoou-gzh-layout
skills.title_zh: Markdown 進去，公眾號編輯器樣式直接粘貼出來
skills.tagline_zh: Word、PDF、純文本都能進，按你的主題偏好自動配好章節編號、引言卡片、代碼塊和署名區。
skills.tagline_en: Accepts Word, PDF, or plain text. Auto-applies your theme: section numbers, callouts, code blocks, TOC.
skills.desc_en: 微信公眾號文章排版引擎，將 Markdown、Word、PDF 或純文本轉換為可直接粘貼到公眾號編輯器的 HTML，並按 xiaoou 的排版偏好選擇主題、章節編號、關鍵詞標記、引言卡片、目錄、代碼塊、圖片/GIF 和署名區。用戶提到公眾號排版、微信排版、自動排版、一鍵排版、gzh，或要求生成自定義公眾號主題時使用。不用於普通網頁、落地頁、PPT 或代寫文章。
skills.why_zh: 它把排版偏好固化成主題，輸入雜格式、輸出統一風格；目錄、關鍵詞標記、圖片/GIF 位置都替你決定好。
skills.why_en: Encodes your layout taste into a reusable theme. Mixed inputs, one consistent visual voice. It decides structure details so you.
skills.limit_zh: 只輸出公眾號編輯器可粘貼的 HTML，不負責生成圖片、不處理複雜表格、不適用於普通網頁或 PPT。
skills.limit_en: Outputs paste-ready HTML for WeChat editor only. No image generation, no complex tables, not for web pages or PPT. Final preview in editor required.
skills.title_en: Markdown in, WeChat editor-ready styled HTML out

skills.name: chinese-font-selector
skills.title_zh: 中文字體選配不靠眼緣，靠授權安全分級和場景矩陣
skills.tagline_zh: 小紅書卡片、產品冊、網頁、圖書、海報——每個場景先查授權再談氣質。內置 OFL 鐵穩/廠商免費/慎用三級，避頭尾。
skills.tagline_en: From Xiaohongshu cards to book layouts—license check before style talk. OFL-safe / vendor-free / caution tiers.
skills.desc_en: 中文字體選配與排版決策專家。為中文為主的設計場景（小紅書卡片、產品冊/宣傳物料、 網頁/UI、圖書內頁排版、海報標題）選擇可免費商用的中文字體並給出中英混排方案。 內置授權安全分級（開源 OFL 鐵穩 / 廠商免費商用 / 慎用），場景×氣質選字矩陣， 中文排版規則（字號階梯、行距、標點、避頭尾）。當用戶要求"選字體/字體搭配/字體推薦/ 中文排版/小紅書字體/產品冊字體/網頁字體/標題字體"，或任何中文視覺設計任務涉及字體 決策時觸發。Triggers on: 中文字體, 中文字體推薦, 字體選擇, 字體搭配, 字體配對, 字體篩選, 字體審美, 免費商用字體, 可商用字體, 開源字體, 思源黑體, 思源宋體, 霞鶩文楷, 得意黑, 中文排版, 中英混排, 小紅書字體, 海報字體, 標題字體, Chinese font, Chinese typography, CJK fonts, Ch
skills.why_zh: 不拿審美當藉口跳過法律風險。把字體決策拆成授權安全、場景氣質、排版規則三層，先篩掉不能商用的。
skills.why_en: Refuses to let taste skip legal risk. Splits font choice into license safety, scene tone, and typography rules—filters out.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋中文為主的設計場景，不含純英文排版、品牌 VI 全案、動態字體。免費商用判斷基於內置庫。
skills.limit_en: Chinese-first layouts only; no pure-Latin type, VI systems, or motion type. License data frozen at 2026—new fonts or license changes need manual.
skills.title_en: Chinese font pairing with license safety tiers & scene.

skills.name: reference-first-motion-director
skills.title_zh: 先出整片視覺總表，再逐鏡找參考的導演工作流
skills.tagline_zh: 口播稿不直接進剪輯，先路由成人物/證據/錄屏/素材四類鏡頭，存好總表和動效清單，再為每鏡檢索精確參考。
skills.tagline_en: Don't cut talking-head raw. Route script into人物/證據/錄屏/素材 shots, save a master visual plan, then fetch exact.
skills.desc_en: 以本地《剪輯學習》知識庫為依據的整片視覺導演與動態包裝工作流。用於把口播腳本、字幕或文案路由為人物、真實證據、錄屏、現有素材與重點動效；先保存整片視覺總表和動效清單，再為每個選定單元檢索精確參考，交付一張嚴格 2K 的成片級參考圖和一條按內容定時的 AI 視頻提示詞。也用於吸收、歸檔和分析用戶新增的圖片或視頻參考。用戶提到視覺導演、整片畫面規劃、動效參考、先出圖、MiniMax/H3 視頻提示詞或補充案例庫時使用。
skills.why_zh: 先定整片視覺骨架再逐鏡找參考，避免邊剪邊想導致的風格漂移；本地知識庫讓參考檢索可追溯、可複用。
skills.why_en: Locks the film's visual skeleton before per-shot reference hunting, preventing style drift mid-edit. Local knowledge base makes.
skills.limit_zh: 只認本地《剪輯學習》知識庫，未先建庫或庫內無對應案例時它不會硬編；產物止於 2K 參考圖和視頻提示詞。
skills.limit_en: Requires local '剪輯學習' KB; won't fabricate refs if absent. Output ends at 2K still + video prompt — no actual edit/composite. Timing needs a script.
skills.title_en: Visual-director workflow: shot list first, then per-shot.

skills.name: clawteam-directors-orchestrator
skills.title_zh: 31位導演的分鏡會，你當主席還是當觀眾
skills.tagline_zh: 寫劇本卡在第三幕？讓庫布里克和諾蘭在後臺吵一架，你只負責拍板。多智能體辯論投票，每次產出都帶導演署名和理由。
skills.tagline_en: Stuck at Act III? Let Kubrick and Nolan argue in the background while you just call the shots. Multi-agent debate.
skills.desc_en: ClawTeam導演智囊團——基於ClawTeam多智能體框架的世界著名導演協同創作系統。 整合31位全球頂級導演的風格思想，通過多智能體協作機制（順序鏈、辯論投票、主席團模式） 輔助劇本創作、影像風格設計和敘事決策。 觸發詞：「導演智囊團」「ClawTeam」「多導演協作」「劇本創作」「影像風格」 適用場景：編劇、導演、創意策劃、影視教育、AI影像創作
skills.why_zh: 不是風格混搭，是機制性對抗：順序鏈推劇情、辯論投票逼出衝突、主席團模式強制收斂。
skills.why_en: Not style blending but engineered conflict: sequential chains push plot, debate votes force clashes, chair mode converges. Every.
skills.limit_zh: 只輸出創作建議與分鏡描述，不生成可直接拍攝的完整劇本格式（無場景編號/對白格式規範）。
skills.limit_en: Outputs creative suggestions & shot descriptions only, not production-ready script format (no scene numbers/dialogue specs). You must integrate into.
skills.title_en: 31 directors' storyboard meeting, you chair or watch

skills.name: code-review
skills.title_zh: 合代碼前先過一遍倉庫規矩的 gh 評審員
skills.tagline_zh: PR 一上來就按你倉庫的約定逐條核對，不靠通用模板。它先讀 CONTRIBUTING 和現有代碼風格，再挑刺。
skills.tagline_en: Checks each PR against your codebase's stated rules, not generic templates. Reads CONTRIBUTING and code style.
skills.desc_en: Reviews GitHub CLI (gh) pull requests against codebase conventions
skills.why_zh: 它不套通用規則，而是先解析倉庫裡的約定文件，再對照 PR 逐項檢查，像老同事一樣懂你們項目的脾氣。
skills.why_en: It adapts to your project's conventions instead of applying generic rules, parsing local docs and style to catch what matters to.
skills.limit_zh: 只針對 GitHub CLI 的 PR 做靜態審查，不跑測試、不查運行時問題；需要倉庫有明確的約定文檔。
skills.limit_en: Only static review of gh PRs; no tests or runtime checks. Needs explicit convention docs in repo, else advice stays generic.
skills.title_en: A gh reviewer that checks PRs against repo rules

skills.name: ci
skills.title_zh: GitLab CI 黑屋裡先摸清牆再動手的探路杖
skills.tagline_zh: 在無頭 CI 裡兩眼一抹黑？它先確認倉庫、認證、工具鏈，再教你怎麼讀 GitLab 狀態、查失敗日誌。
skills.tagline_en: Lost in a headless CI job? It checks out, authenticates, maps tools, then shows how to read GitLab state and.
skills.desc_en: Use when running headless inside a GitLab CI job in the Gramax repo (the `ai` job). Establishes environment — repo checked out, glab/gh authenticated, what tools exist, how to read/post on GitLab, how to diagnose failed pipeline jobs. Triggers on "ci", "running in CI", "headless CI job", "ты в CI", "запущен в пайплайне".
skills.why_zh: 不急著跑命令，先建立環境心智模型：倉庫在哪、憑據通不通、有哪些工具、怎麼和 GitLab 對話。
skills.why_en: It prioritizes orientation over action: verifies checkout, auth, and tooling before any command. Debugging means knowing where.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 Gramax 倉庫的 `ai` 作業，且必須已有 glab/gh 認證。不處理其他 CI 平臺、不寫代碼。
skills.limit_en: Only for Gramax repo's `ai` job with glab/gh pre-authenticated. No other CI platforms, no code writing, no pipeline fixes. Outside that, it says 'I.
skills.title_en: CI job survival kit: orient, diagnose, act

skills.name: tenstorrent
skills.title_zh: 跳過網頁控制台，直接調 Tenstorrent 全家
skills.tagline_zh: 聊天、畫圖、視頻、TTS、STT 一個 Skill 全包。不用開瀏覽器、不用記 API 文檔。
skills.tagline_en: Skip the web UI. Trigger chat, image, video, TTS, STT from your terminal with a single skill. No browser, no API.
skills.desc_en: Use Tenstorrent console.tenstorrent.com models across chat, image, video, TTS, and STT. Triggers: tenstorrent, 텐스토렌트, Torendissi, 토렌디시, Wan2.2, T2V, text-to-video, image jobs, SDXL, tt-sd3.5, tt-z-image-turbo, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, tts-1, whisper-large-v3.
skills.why_zh: 把 console.tenstorrent.com 的模型全收進一個觸發詞，連 Wan2.2。
skills.why_en: Packs the entire console.tenstorrent.com model lineup behind one trigger word—Wan2.2, SDXL, DeepSeek-R1 included. Feels like.
skills.limit_zh: 需要 Tenstorrent 賬號和有效 API 密鑰；只覆蓋 console.tenstorrent.com 上架模。
skills.limit_en: Requires Tenstorrent account & API key. Covers only console.tenstorrent.com models, not local/third-party. Remote quota limits apply.
skills.title_en: One command to reach all Tenstorrent console models: chat.

skills.name: duizuo-reading-companion
skills.title_zh: 讀書記不住進度？它替你記著，還防劇透
skills.tagline_zh: 小說、散文、非虛構都能陪讀。它記住你讀到哪、什麼感受，下次接著聊，絕不提前劇透。讀不下去時，它會問你怎麼了。
skills.tagline_en: For novels, essays, nonfiction. It tracks where you are and how you feel, picks up next time, and won't spoil a.
skills.desc_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading companionship for novels, short-story and essay collections, mixed anthologies, and nonfiction. Use when the reader is preparing to read, reading, stuck, reacting, interpreting, evaluating, or debriefing a book. It remembers edition, medium, status, and content-appropriate progress; verifies text claims; adapts each turn to plot, emotion, aesthetics, interpretation,
skills.why_zh: 它把讀書變成有狀態的對話：記得版本、媒介、進度，還能驗證文本細節。每次回應都貼合當下情節。
skills.why_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading chats. It remembers edition, medium, and progress, verifies text claims, and adapts to plot.
skills.limit_zh: 只支持文本類書籍，不處理有聲書或視頻；需要你主動彙報進度，它不會自動翻頁；對長篇複雜情節的跨章記憶有限。
skills.limit_en: Text-only; no audiobooks/video. You must report progress; it won't auto-sync. Cross-chapter memory is limited; very long books may need manual resets.
skills.title_en: A reading companion that remembers your place and never.

skills.name: agentmemory-agents
skills.title_zh: 只認官方適配器，裝錯路徑當場報錯的內存接線員
skills.tagline_zh: 裝 agentmemory 到宿主編碼 agent 時，它替你核對 connect 命令該寫哪個配置路徑。
skills.tagline_en: When wiring agentmemory into a host coding agent, it double-checks which config path the connect command should.
skills.desc_en: How agentmemory wires into host coding agents via the connect command. Use when installing agentmemory into a specific agent, when asked which agents are supported, or when a connect adapter writes the wrong config path.
skills.why_zh: 機制上它不猜：每個 connect 適配器都帶白名單路徑校驗，寫錯位置直接停下告訴你。
skills.why_en: It never guesses: every connect adapter ships with whitelisted path validation, halting on mismatch instead of silently writing.
skills.limit_zh: 只管 agentmemory 的 connect 接線，不覆蓋記憶檢索、存儲或向量化邏輯。只認官方列出的宿主 agen。
skills.limit_en: Only handles agentmemory's connect wiring; no retrieval/storage/vector logic. Supports only officially listed host agents; custom agents need your.
skills.title_en: Memory wiring that rejects wrong adapter paths

skills.name: chinese-lesson-plan
skills.title_zh: 先問教材版本再落筆的備課助手，連分層作業一起出
skills.tagline_zh: 備課最怕架空課標。它先鎖定學段、版本和課標，再按核心素養排可觀察任務，最後連分層作業和說課稿都遞到你手上。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of lesson plans floating in the air? It locks in grade, edition, and curriculum standard, then builds.
skills.desc_en: 生成中國中小學教案與配套材料。當用戶要"備課""寫教案""設計一節課""做課件大綱""出分層作業""寫說課稿""評課"時使用。覆蓋語文/數學/英語/科學等學科，小學到高中；先確認學段、教材版本與適用課程標準，再按學科核心素養、可觀察任務和評價證據組織目標。
skills.why_zh: 不是模板堆砌，而是以評價證據倒推教學目標——每個任務都能對應到可觀察的學生行為，讓教案經得起教研組追問。
skills.why_en: Backward design done right: every objective maps to observable student behavior and assessment evidence, so your plan survives.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋中國課標（含部編/人教版等主流版本），不含港澳臺及國際課程；產出為教案與配套材料文本，不生成PPT文件本身。
skills.limit_en: Mainland China curricula only (PEP, 部編, etc.), no HK/MO/TW or IB/AP. Outputs text-based plans & materials, not PPT files.
skills.title_en: Lesson planner that pins down textbook edition before.

skills.name: lieflat-less-ai-tone
skills.title_zh: 只刪清單上那七種AI腔，其餘一字不動
skills.tagline_zh: 成稿後過一遍，把「值得注意的是」「總的來說」這類機器慣用語揪出來改掉。不在清單裡的句子原樣放行，不重排段落。
skills.tagline_en: Post-draft pass that catches only whitelisted AI tics like 'it's worth noting'—everything else stays exactly as.
skills.desc_en: 按 SKILL.md 明確列出的規則識別並改寫寫作中的 AI 痕跡。只能處理清單內的問題；未命中規則的文字必須原樣保留，也不能改變文章框架。適用於寫作完成後的成稿清理。 Remove AI writing tells using an explicit whitelist of rules; leaves unmatched text untouched.
skills.why_zh: 靠顯式白名單而非模型直覺，改什麼由你定死。規則透明可審計，不會自作主張把個人風格也當AI味洗掉。
skills.why_en: Explicit whitelist instead of model vibes—you control exactly what gets edited. Auditable rules won't mistake your personal.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理SKILL.md列出的規則；未命中文字原樣保留。不識別清單外的AI痕跡，也不動文章框架。適合成稿清理。
skills.limit_en: Only edits patterns listed in SKILL.md; unmatched text stays untouched. Won't catch off-list tells or restructure content. For final-pass cleanup.
skills.title_en: Removes only whitelisted AI tells, leaves the rest untouched

skills.name: encoding-hero-video-for-mobile
skills.title_zh: 手機豎屏 hero 視頻壓片臺，只管碼率不管播放
skills.tagline_zh: 母帶壓成 9:16 網頁背景 mp4，或現有手機片碼率太高卡頓要重壓。只做壓制與碼率，不碰播放驗證，省心不越界。
skills.tagline_en: Compress master to 9:16 web bg mp4, or re-encode choppy mobile video. Handles encoding & bitrate only, no.
skills.desc_en: 當要把一支影片母帶壓成手機用（9:16 直式）的網頁背景／hero mp4、或現有手機片碼率太高在手機上會卡而要重壓的時候用。只管壓制與碼率，不含播放驗證（那是 verifying-hero-video-on-mobile）。
skills.why_zh: 專注單一動作：壓片。不摻播放驗證，避免職責混淆。預設針對手機豎屏場景，碼率控制精準，減少反覆試錯。
skills.why_en: Single-purpose encoding tool. No playback verification mixed in. Tuned for mobile portrait, precise bitrate control, fewer.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理視頻編碼與碼率調整，不含播放驗證。需提供母帶或高碼率源文件；不處理橫屏轉豎屏裁剪，也不做字幕或特效合成。
skills.limit_en: Encodes & adjusts bitrate only; no playback verification. Needs source/master file; no crop/rotate, no subtitles or effects.
skills.title_en: Mobile vertical hero video encoder, bitrate only

skills.name: lieflat-charts
skills.title_zh: 圖表先問數據語義再選色，報告模板十二套
skills.tagline_zh: 從真實圖表庫實現生成 HTML，不靠截圖或手寫。十二套中英整頁報告模板，地圖只在你要時才啟用，色系不混搭。
skills.tagline_en: Real chart implementations, not screenshots. 12 full-page report templates in CN/EN. Maps only on request.
skills.desc_en: 一套模板驅動的數據可視化與報告生成 skill，既能嚴格從 Lupi、Basics、Glance、Maps 與 Interactive gallery 的真實實現生成 HTML 圖表，也能從 12 套中英文整頁報告模板生成可發布的 HTML 報告；以 Mono 為保底，能按數據語義自動選擇內置彩色預設，也支持用戶明確提供的自定義色板。地圖僅在用戶明確要求時啟用，同一交付禁止混用色系。
skills.why_zh: 以 Mono 為保底，按數據語義自動挑彩色預設，也可用你給的色板——但同一份交付絕不混色系。
skills.why_en: Mono as fallback, semantic auto-palette, custom swatches allowed—but never mixed in one deliverable, so reports look art-directed.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 Lupi/Basics/Glance/Maps/Interactive 五類圖表實現；地圖必須顯式點名才啟用。
skills.limit_en: Only Lupi/Basics/Glance/Maps/Interactive chart types. Maps need explicit opt-in. 12 fixed report templates; beyond that, extend yourself.
skills.title_en: Charts that pick palettes by data semantics, 12 report.

skills.name: eli5
skills.title_zh: 把任何概念講成帶大圖的幼兒園繪本
skills.tagline_zh: 正文只有一句：「把我當成對這個話題完全不懂的人，用大圖、少字的 HTML 頁面講明白。」輸出不是一段話，是一頁能順著往下看的圖文。
skills.tagline_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
skills.desc_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
skills.why_zh: 它證明 skill 不必複雜：改變的不是信息量，是理解路徑——從「讀一大段」變成「順著標題和圖往下看」。
skills.why_en: It shows a skill need not be complex — what changes is not the amount of information but the path to understanding.
skills.limit_zh: 整份 SKILL.md 只有一句指令，效果全看你的 agent 會不會做 HTML；不會出圖的環境裡它就退化成一段普通解釋。裝的是 anthropics/claude-plugins-community 這個 31 件合集裡的一個路徑。
skills.limit_en: One sentence; the result depends entirely on whether your agent can render HTML. Installed as one path inside a 31-skill community plugin repo.
skills.title_en: Explain anything as a big-picture HTML page for a total.

skills.name: window-scenery
skills.title_zh: 左下角永遠釘著地名徽章的車窗風景照
skills.tagline_zh: 坐在車裡想發朋友圈，卻總拍出反光玻璃和髒邊框？它直接生成從車窗望出去的寫實風景，每張左下角自動蓋好地名徽章。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of glare and dirty frames in your car-window shots? It renders photorealistic views from any vehicle, each.
skills.desc_en: Generate photorealistic travel images from inside vehicles looking out through windows, with a consistent lower-left location badge. Use when the user asks for "車窗裡的風景", "車窗美景", window-view scenery, travel photos from a car/train/boat/plane/cable-car window, or batch image prompts for locations viewed from transportation.
skills.why_zh: 不是簡單貼圖，而是把車窗框、玻璃反光和窗外景深一起算出來，徽章位置固定，批量出圖時風格統一得像同一臺相。
skills.why_en: It composites frame, glass reflections, and depth in one pass, with a fixed badge spot—so batch outputs look shot on the same.
skills.limit_zh: 只認交通工具窗景（車/船/飛機/纜車），不生成窗外特寫或人像；地名徽章僅限左下角，不能改位置；要真實地名需自備列表。
skills.limit_en: Only vehicle-window scenery (car/boat/plane/cable car); no close-ups or people. Badge stays bottom-left. Real place names need your list—else it.
skills.title_en: Window-view travel shots with a pinned location badge

skills.name: wtf
skills.title_zh: 上線前先替你拆雷的 AI 項目體檢員
skills.tagline_zh: 提交前問一句「這能發嗎」？它掃結構、密鑰、遷移、鑑權，專治 AI 寫代碼留下的隱蔽坑。
skills.tagline_en: Ask before you ship or commit. It sweeps structure, secrets, migrations, auth—catches AI-coded traps three layers.
skills.desc_en: Pre-launch and pre-commit audit for vibe coding projects. Use when asked to check whether a project is ready to ship, deploy, merge, or commit, especially for common AI-built app mistakes: broken project structure, committed secrets or cache files, environment variable hygiene, database migrations, ORM/schema drift, unsafe raw SQL, unused legacy code, dead routes/components, weak auth, missing tes
skills.why_zh: 不是泛泛的 lint，而是按「AI 項目常見死法」逐項盤查：密鑰洩漏、ORM 漂移、死路由、弱鑑權。
skills.why_en: Not a generic linter—it audits against known AI-project failure modes: leaked secrets, schema drift, dead routes, weak auth.
skills.limit_zh: 只審代碼倉庫狀態，不跑測試、不查運行時性能；對純前端靜態頁或單文件腳本覆蓋有限。
skills.limit_en: Audits repo state only—no test runs, no runtime perf. Limited on static pages or single-file scripts; needs git history or readable structure, else.
skills.title_en: Pre-launch auditor that defuses AI-coded landmines

skills.name: site-repair
skills.title_zh: 交付後網站改不動、內容消失，它進場查修
skills.tagline_zh: 客戶說照片換不了、CMS 存完內容就沒了、上傳崩了構建——它不重做，只針對已交付的舊版本站點做狀態診斷與修復。
skills.tagline_en: Client can't swap a photo, CMS saves vanish, uploads break the build—it diagnoses and repairs already-delivered.
skills.desc_en: Check and repair a marketing site that has already been delivered — a client who cannot change a photograph or a section on their own site, content that disappeared after they saved in the CMS, uploads that vanish or turn the build red, or a site built from an older version of this kit whose state is unknown. Use when someone reports that a delivered site cannot be edited, when content went missin
skills.why_zh: 它認的是「交付後狀態未知」的站點，不是從零建站。能定位是 CMS 寫入鏈路。
skills.why_en: Built for post-handoff unknowns, not greenfield builds. It traces failures to CMS write paths, upload pipelines, or legacy kit.
skills.limit_zh: 只認本 kit 生成並已交付的營銷站；不接非 kit 站點、不處理設計改版、不負責 CMS 賬號權限。
skills.limit_en: Only for sites built from this kit and already delivered. No non-kit sites, redesigns, or CMS permission issues. Manual structural edits may mislead.
skills.title_en: Post-delivery site repair: edits fail, content vanishes

skills.name: pdf-proof
skills.title_zh: PDF 裡哪個數在哪一頁，截圖圈給你看
skills.tagline_zh: 核對合同、報表、聊天記錄裡的數字時，不用再翻頁找半天。它直接定位到那一行，高亮截圖，讓你拿著圖去對質。
skills.tagline_en: Cross-checking numbers in contracts or reports? It jumps to the exact line, highlights it, and hands you a.
skills.desc_en: Use this skill when the user needs visual proof that specific values exist in a PDF — not just to read a PDF, but to see exactly where a number, amount, clause, or field appears on the page with a highlighted screenshot. Trigger when someone is cross-referencing a PDF against something else (a form they're filling out, a claim, a conversation, another document) and needs confirmation with evidence
skills.why_zh: 不是摘要，不是引用——它把視覺證據直接釘在頁面上。你看到的就是對方看到的。
skills.why_en: No summaries, no quotes—it nails visual proof right on the page. What you see is what they see, ending the 'go check page X'.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 PDF 文件內的文字層；掃描版或圖片型 PDF 需先經 OCR 才能用。高亮截圖止於單頁。
skills.limit_en: Text-layer PDFs only; scanned/image PDFs need OCR first. Highlights are per-page—multi-page continuous paragraphs aren't stitched together.
skills.title_en: Pinpoint a value in a PDF with a highlighted screenshot

skills.name: styleseed
skills.title_zh: 只認當前畫布邊界，把 StyleSeed 請求派給唯
skills.tagline_zh: 你說「幫我弄下風格」時，它先分清你在改哪張圖、哪段文，再只調對應那套 ss-* 技能——不讓你在六個相似入口裡瞎猜。
skills.tagline_en: When you say "help with StyleSeed," it checks which artifact you're editing, then calls only the matching ss-*.
skills.desc_en: Route a StyleSeed request to exactly one first workflow after resolving the current artifact boundary. Use when the user asks generally for StyleSeed help rather than invoking one specific ss-* skill.
skills.why_zh: 別的路由靠關鍵詞猜意圖，它靠解析當前畫布邊界做硬判斷——邊界沒變就鎖死同一流程，變了才換，杜絕誤調。
skills.why_en: Others guess intent by keywords; this one resolves the artifact boundary first and locks the workflow until that boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 只做路由，不執行任何風格操作。若當前畫布為空或邊界模糊（如同時選中多類對象），它會停下問你，不會替你選。
skills.limit_en: Routes only, never applies styles. If canvas is empty or boundary ambiguous (multi-type selection), it stops and asks—won't guess.
skills.title_en: Route StyleSeed to the one right workflow, by artifact.

skills.name: itr-wala
skills.title_zh: 舊新稅制並排算完再決定報哪套的印度報稅員
skills.tagline_zh: 從 Form 16 到新舊稅制對比，再到 Zerodha 資本利得，一個技能走完 FY25-26 報稅。
skills.tagline_en: From Form 16 to old-vs-new regime, plus Zerodha capital gains—one skill for FY25-26 ITR. No more ten tabs for 80C.
skills.desc_en: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax,
skills.why_zh: 它把 AIS/TIS/26AS 的 TDS 對賬和資本利得解析做成了同一套數據流。
skills.why_en: It wires TDS reconciliation from AIS/26AS and capital-gains parsing into one data flow—not separate prompts. Tax is computed.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27，且僅覆蓋 ITR-1/2/3/4。不處理公司稅、GST。
skills.limit_en: FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 only, ITR-1/2/3/4. No corporate tax, GST, or non-resident filing; prior-year or foreign-income inputs cause a hard stop, not.
skills.title_en: Indian tax filer that computes old vs new regime.

skills.name: bigfish-ink-wash-photo
skills.title_zh: 不重繪只錨定主體走向，落筆前先定畫心與延展向
skills.tagline_zh: 不是精確重建，只保留關鍵的識別錨點；生成前先看照片定畫幅方向，按主體延展、空間流向和視覺中心分布來定。
skills.tagline_en: Not reconstruction — only essential identifying anchors; canvas direction is decided from the photo's subject extension and visual center before generating.
skills.desc_en: Not reconstruction — only essential identifying anchors; canvas direction is decided from the photo's subject extension and visual center before generating.
skills.why_zh: 它明確要避開兩種假貨：貼上去的寫實主體，和果凍感的 AI 水彩筆觸。
skills.why_en: It explicitly avoids two fakes: photorealistic pasted subjects, and jelly-like AI watercolor marks.
skills.limit_zh: 要先讀完 references/generation-prompt.md 才動手——作者寫成了硬步驟。只保留錨點意味著細節大量丟失，想認出人臉的別裝。只出圖。
skills.limit_en: Read references/generation-prompt.md in full first — a hard step. Anchors only means heavy detail loss.
skills.title_en: Anchor subject & canvas direction first, then ink-wash

skills.name: tait-crt-interface-skill
skills.title_zh: CRT 屏曲邊加三檔中文預設的誇張位圖漫畫窗
skills.tagline_zh: 早期 Macintosh／Minitel 式窗口下面一張誇張的位圖諷刺畫，桶形彎曲的屏幕邊，三套中文預設：街頭怪誕、巨像符號、冷面幾何。
skills.tagline_en: An exaggerated bitmap editorial caricature beneath early Macintosh / Minitel-style windows, barrel-curved CRT edges, three Chinese presets.
skills.desc_en: An exaggerated bitmap editorial caricature beneath early Macintosh / Minitel-style windows, barrel-curved CRT edges, three Chinese presets.
skills.why_zh: 它禁止描摹和自動像素化——每個主體是重新繪製的獨立身份，共用一套像素網格，中間調只許用受限的棋盤格。
skills.why_en: No tracing, no auto-pixelation — each subject is re-authored as a distinct identity on one shared pixel lattice.
skills.limit_zh: 生成前有兩段強制問答：調色板和畫幅比例沒給就先問你。標題欄簽名不可去掉。一次只出一張。正文 3.7 萬字節，很吃上下文。
skills.limit_en: A strict two-stage intake asks for palette and aspect ratio if not supplied; the title-bar signature is immutable; one image per run.
skills.title_en: Exaggerated bitmap comic in CRT windows with 3 Chinese.

skills.name: competitor-gap
skills.title_zh: 專挖對手有而你沒有的搜索詞，按流量和可贏性排好序
skills.tagline_zh: 別再猜對手憑什麼排你前面。輸入對方域名，直接列出你缺哪些詞、每個詞能帶來多少流量、值不值得搶。附可贏性評分。
skills.tagline_en: Stop guessing why they outrank you. Enter a competitor domain, get the exact keywords you're missing, ranked by.
skills.desc_en: Find keywords a competitor ranks for that the user's site doesn't — the content gap, prioritized by volume and winnability. Use when asked "what does competitor.com rank for", "keyword gap vs X", "steal competitor keywords", or "why do they outrank us".
skills.why_zh: 不是簡單差集。它把每個缺口詞按搜索量和你的現有排名綜合打分，告訴你先搶哪個、哪個搶了也白搶。
skills.why_en: Not just a keyword diff. It scores each gap by search volume and your current rank, telling you which battles to fight first.
skills.limit_zh: 只認公開搜索數據，不覆蓋 Google Ads 私有詞或長尾意圖；需要你已配置搜索 API 密鑰。產物是候選詞表。
skills.limit_en: Uses public search data only; no private Ads terms or long-tail intent. Requires your own Search API key. Output is a keyword list, not content or.
skills.title_en: Keyword gap vs competitor, sorted by volume & winnability

skills.name: dataset-curation
skills.title_zh: 會先問『這數據對誰不公平』的數據集體檢員
skills.tagline_zh: 別人只報準確率，它先查性別、地域、收入分層是否失衡。自動生成分層採樣方案，連採集計劃裡的倫理坑都標出來。
skills.tagline_en: While others report accuracy, it flags gender, region, income imbalances. Auto-generates stratified sampling.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user wants to analyze dataset bias, create stratified samples, evaluate fairness, or plan dataset collection. Triggers on phrases like "dataset bias", "stratified sample", "class imbalance", "data distribution", "fairness analysis", or "ethical review".
skills.why_zh: 不是事後補救，而是從源頭盯住偏見：把『公平』拆成可計算的分布差異指標，讓每個採樣決策都帶著倫理尺子。
skills.why_en: Proactive bias detection: turns 'fairness' into measurable distribution gaps, guiding every sampling choice with an ethical ruler.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋表格型數據，不處理圖像/文本；需提供敏感屬性列名，否則無法分析；輸出為報告與建議，不自動修改數據。
skills.limit_en: Tabular data only; needs sensitive attribute column names; outputs report & suggestions, no auto-fixes.
skills.title_en: Dataset Auditor That Asks 'Who Does This Data Unfairly.

skills.name: jingtian-style
skills.title_zh: 一份會替你按住抒情衝動的第一人稱記賬筆
skills.tagline_zh: 短行白描、數字替情緒、稱謂即關係、空置收尾——把情緒藏進勞動鏡頭裡，第一人稱記賬體，剋制到不像廣告。
skills.tagline_en: Short lines, numbers over feelings, titles as status, labor shots, empty endings—a restrained first-person ledger.
skills.desc_en: 把任意文稿改寫成《我的女友景甜》體（景甜體）：短行白描、抵押對位、外圍勞動鏡頭、數字代替情緒、稱謂即關係狀態、以空置與「什麼都不發生」收束的第一人稱記賬文案。 Use when the user asks for 景甜體、孫宇晨體、孫哥文案、《我的女友景甜》風格、景甜式文案、景甜體改寫、記賬體改寫、剋制文風改寫, or says 改成景甜體 / 用景甜體重寫 / 寫成孫宇晨那種記賬體, or asks for Justin Sun style / justinsun write style, or runs /jingtian-style.
skills.why_zh: 不是仿寫，是結構復刻：抵押對位、外圍勞動、空置收束，每一句都有機制可循，改完自帶景甜體的冷感。
skills.why_en: Not imitation—structural replication: mortgage mirroring, peripheral labor, empty closure. Every line follows a mechanism.
skills.limit_zh: 只認中文輸入，英文稿會先譯再改；只產出文案本身，不負責排版或配圖；若原文無具體數字或勞動細節，需先補足才能動筆。
skills.limit_en: Chinese input only (English gets translated first). Output is text only—no layout or images. Needs concrete numbers or labor details; if absent.
skills.title_en: A first-person ledger pen that holds back your lyricism

skills.name: starryear-threefold-memory
skills.title_zh: 照片分三層：記憶碎片、證據原件、心情路線圖
skills.tagline_zh: 上層把照片重組成大塊不規則碎片的視覺記憶，中層原片不動當證據，下層把路線、方向、情緒畫成一張記憶地圖。
skills.tagline_en: Top: the photo recomposed as large fragments of visual memory. Middle: the untouched photo as evidence. Bottom: route, direction and mood drawn as a memory map.
skills.desc_en: Top: the photo recomposed as large fragments of visual memory. Middle: the untouched photo as evidence. Bottom: route, direction and mood drawn as a memory map.
skills.why_zh: 它規定每一條路線、節點、碎片、圖標、配色都必須從這張照片推出來，不許寫死地點，也不許套裝飾性的星座。
skills.why_en: Every route, node, fragment, pictogram and palette must derive from this photo — no hard-coded places, no decorative constellations.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃一張鎖定的照片，三層等高豎排，版式不可改。下層的「記憶地圖」是從照片推的空間信號，不是真地圖，別拿它導航。倉裡 3 個 SKILL.md，這是主件。
skills.limit_en: One locked photo, three equal stacked panels, fixed layout. The map is a spatial signal, not navigation.
skills.title_en: Photo in 3 layers: memory fragments, raw evidence, mood map

skills.name: yueyuan
skills.title_zh: 先立假設再找證據的子平八字推演臺
skills.tagline_zh: 不信一眼斷命。它把《淵海子平》到《窮通寶鑑》拆成可複核的規則層，每步留證據、標不確定度，盲派交叉驗證後才給結論。
skills.tagline_en: No snap judgments. It layers Ziping classics into auditable rules, grades evidence A–E, cross-checks with Blind.
skills.desc_en: 【專業子平八字分析系統】融合《淵海子平》《子平真詮》《滴天髓》《窮通寶鑑》正統子平體系與盲派交叉驗證的專業命盤分析。核心特色：研究型流程（假設-證據-反證）、規則分層與衝突裁決（STRUCTURAL>CORE>SCHOOL>HEURISTIC>SUPPLEMENTAL）、證據分級 A-E、預註冊預測與兩階段盲驗證、競爭假設與不確定度、用神六維一致性檢查、多流派合議。覆蓋：排盤校驗、旺衰判斷（人元司令分野）、八格格局成敗與相神、病藥論、調候、十神斷法、六親、干支作用、空亡神煞、大運流年分析順序、應期斷法、婚戀/事業/財富/身心分領域分析。觸發詞：八字、四柱、排盤、命理、喜用神、格局、旺衰、調候、大運流年、應期、合婚、子平、盲派、十神。
skills.why_zh: 別的 skill 給結論，它給裁決鏈。規則分五級、衝突有優先級，用神過六維檢查才放行——像審稿人。
skills.why_en: Others give answers; this one shows rulings. Five rule tiers with conflict arbitration, six-dimensional Yong Shen checks—a peer.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋子平體系與盲派交叉驗證，不碰紫微斗數、奇門遁甲。需用戶提供公曆出生時間與地點；無準確時辰則旺衰。
skills.limit_en: Ziping + Blind School only; no Ziwei or Qimen. Needs exact birth time & place; without it, strength and pattern verdicts downgrade to 'uncertain'.
skills.title_en: Ziping Bazi analysis that pre-registers hypotheses

skills.name: hydo-self-improve
skills.title_zh: 改完先跑測試和截圖，才把分支交回給你的自我改造工具
skills.tagline_zh: 想給 Hydo 加功能又怕弄壞正在用的它？在一次性工作樹裡改，跑測試、構建、截真圖，最後只交回一個分支。
skills.tagline_en: Add features to Hydo without breaking your running setup: edit in a throwaway worktree, verify with tests + real.
skills.desc_en: Change Hydo itself — safely. Work in a throwaway git worktree, verify with tests, build and a real screenshot, and hand back a branch. Never edit the running app, never touch app data, never merge.
skills.why_zh: 它把“改自己”變成隔離實驗：不碰運行中的程序、不碰數據、不自動合併。驗證靠真實截圖而非嘴說。
skills.why_en: Turns self-modification into an isolated experiment: never touches the live app, never merges. Verification via real screenshot.
skills.limit_zh: 只適用於 Hydo 自身代碼的修改，不碰數據遷移或配置遷移；需要本機有 git 和測試環境；產物止於分支，合併、部署。
skills.limit_en: Only for Hydo source changes — no data/config migration. Needs local git + test env. Output stops at a branch; merge, deploy, release are on you.
skills.title_en: Change Hydo itself: test, screenshot, hand back a branch

skills.name: handover-contract
skills.title_zh: 代碼里長出來的交接文檔，簽字時不用再怕
skills.tagline_zh: 給發出去的活兒寫技術交接書、開發者保護型責任合同、維護合同——按代碼實際生成，風險越高文檔越厚，韓國法基準。
skills.tagline_en: Turn your code into tech handover notes, dev-protective contracts & maintenance terms (Korean law). Heavier docs.
skills.desc_en: 만든 시스템을 발주처·운영자에게 넘길 때 필요한 문서를 코드에 근거해 작성한다 — 기술 인수인계서, 개발자 보호형 인계·운영책임 계약서와 유지보수 계약서(한국법 기준), 개정 검토 패치, 서명용 A4 PDF. 랜딩페이지·홍보사이트부터 쇼핑몰·예약·구독 서비스, 사내 도구, 포인트·마일리지·내부 원장을 다루는 플랫폼까지 분야를 가리지 않고 쓰며, 위험 수준에 맞춰 문서 무게를 조절한다. "인수인계", "핸드오버", "이관", "납품 마무리", "운영책임", "면책", "개발자 책임 범위", "손 떼야 한다", "인계 후 악용", "유지보수 끝내기", "handover", "SI 마무리", "외주 마무리" 같은 말이 나오면 사용한다. 특히 내가 만든 것을 다른 사람이 운영하게 되는 상황에서 회원 데이터·결제·자
skills.why_zh: 文檔不是模板填空，而是從倉庫現狀推導責任邊界。它替你算清哪些風險該寫進合同，哪些操作細節必須留痕。
skills.why_en: Not template-filling: it derives liability boundaries from your actual repo. Spells out which risks belong in the contract and.
skills.limit_zh: 只認韓國法管轄的交接場景；不覆蓋跨國合同、稅務籌劃或口頭交接。文檔止步於簽名版PDF，不代你談判。
skills.limit_en: Korean-law handovers only; no cross-border contracts, tax advice, or verbal deals. Output ends at signed PDF—no negotiation help, no guarantee.
skills.title_en: Handover docs grown from code, safe to sign

skills.name: xhs-cover
skills.title_zh: 先出圖後改字的小紅書封面，風格學一次就記住
skills.tagline_zh: GPT Image 2 打底、Gemini 兜底，封面改字不重畫。你說「學這個風格」，它提取配色排版，下次直接套用。
skills.tagline_en: GPT Image 2 first, Gemini fallback. Edit text without redrawing. Say 'learn this style' and it saves layout &.
skills.desc_en: Generate Xiaohongshu (XHS / RedNote) cover images using GPT Image 2 / Codex image generation first, with the legacy Gemini CLI as fallback. Triggers for cover generation: "生成封面", "小紅書封面", "xhs封面", "製作封面", "幫我做張圖", "XHS cover", "RedNote cover". Triggers for cover editing: "修改封面", "改一下封面", "上一張圖基礎上", "基於這張圖調整", "不要重新做", "edit this cover". Triggers for style learning: "學習這個風格", "提取風格", "我想自定義風格", "這張
skills.why_zh: 把「生成」和「編輯」拆成兩條獨立通道：改字走局部重繪，不推翻整張構圖；風格學習單獨存模板。
skills.why_en: Separates generation from editing: text changes use local repaint, not full redraw. Style learning saves visual patterns only.
skills.limit_zh: 只認 GPT Image 2 和 Gemini CLI 兩條出圖通道，本地無 Gemini 密鑰時編輯功能不可用。
skills.limit_en: Only works with GPT Image 2 or Gemini CLI. No Gemini key = no edit function. Style learning captures visuals, not copy tone. Outputs images only, no.
skills.title_en: XHS cover maker: generate, edit in place, learn styles

skills.name: ontology-driven-dev
skills.title_zh: 需求沒逐條簽字，代碼一行都不生成
skills.tagline_zh: 業務系統開發最怕需求漂移。這套 Skill 用七模型本體鎖死需求、模型、代碼三方對齊，每個探索階段強制人工確認。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of drifting requirements? Seven-model ontology locks alignment across specs, models, and code. Every.
skills.desc_en: 當用戶要基於業務需求，通過「需求探索 → 本體建模 → 應用構建」三步法開發一套完整、可運行的本體驅動 BS(瀏覽器前後端) 業務系統時使用。基於七模型本體 YAML(M1/M2/M3/M5/M6/M7/MU) 與內置 code-paas 技術底座，強制每個需求探索階段人工確認，產出嚴格對齊需求文檔、本體模型與代碼的系統。支持整體觸發與單階段入口(僅建模/僅構建)。觸發詞含：本體驅動、需求探索、本體建模、七模型、code-paas、AI原生應用、業務系統開發。
skills.why_zh: 別人用 prompt 寫代碼，它用 M1/M2/M3/M5/M6/M7/MU 七層本體當施工圖。
skills.why_en: Others generate code from prompts; this uses a 7-layer ontology as blueprint, forcing confirmation at each discovery step. Code.
skills.limit_zh: 只認業務系統開發場景，且必須走完需求探索才能建模構建。單階段入口僅限已有完整七模型 YAML 的項目。
skills.limit_en: Only for business system dev with full discovery first. Single-stage entry needs existing 7-model YAML. No UI polish or deployment; output stops at.
skills.title_en: No code until every requirement is signed off

skills.name: forward-implementation-first
skills.title_zh: 先出活再記賬，別讓臺賬卡住真進度
skills.tagline_zh: 多階段流水線、遷移、長跑實施裡，Agent 常被哈希鎖、驗收章、儀表盤這類臺賬卡住。裝上它，先產出可驗證結果。
skills.tagline_en: In multi-stage pipelines, migrations, or long runs, agents stall on hash locks, cert markers, dashboards. This.
skills.desc_en: Keeps an agent building and validating real output instead of servicing its own bookkeeping. Use for multi-stage pipelines, capability roadmaps, long-running implementation loops, migrations, staged data or build runs, and any run where administrative hashes, locks, receipts, dashboards, certification markers, or progress metadata can block correct work. Use when an agent refuses to advance, rewin
skills.why_zh: 它把「行政性記賬」和「實質推進」拆成兩套優先級：記賬永遠可延遲、可跳過，而產物必須真實可驗。
skills.why_en: It hard-splits administrative bookkeeping from substantive progress—logs are always deferrable, but artifacts must be.
skills.limit_zh: 只適用於有明確中間產物或可驗證輸出的多階段任務；若單步產出無法獨立驗證（如純對話推理），它會失效。
skills.limit_en: Only for multi-stage tasks with verifiable intermediate artifacts; fails on pure conversational reasoning. Doesn't fix permission/env errors—just.
skills.title_en: Build first, bookkeep later—don't let logs stall real work

skills.name: stamp-edge
skills.title_zh: 原圖四周直接打半圓孔，真透明背景的郵票生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 不用摳圖、不用白邊，孔洞處 alpha 全零，拖到深色海報上也乾淨。多張還能自動拼成等寬瀑布流郵票合集。
skills.tagline_en: No white border, no cutout—holes are truly transparent, stack on any dark background. Batch multiple into a clean.
skills.desc_en: 把任意圖片處理成郵票風格——直接在原圖四周邊緣打半圓鋸齒孔洞 + 柔和投影,默認無白邊、輸出真透明背景 PNG(鋸齒孔洞和四周 alpha=0),可直接疊加到任何背景;可選加白色紙邊;還能把多張郵票拼成等寬列瀑布流合集圖(stamp sheet)。當用戶提到"郵票邊"、"郵票風格"、"郵票質感"、"鋸齒邊"、"打孔邊"、"perforated edge"、"stamp style"、"postage stamp"、"郵票合集"、"郵票排版"、"stamp sheet",或要求把截圖/帖子/圖片做成郵票效果時使用。
skills.why_zh: 孔洞不是畫上去的白色模擬，而是 alpha=0 的真透明；投影柔和且只在孔洞外緣，疊深色底不露灰塊。
skills.why_en: Perforations are true alpha-zero cutouts, not white paint; soft shadow stays outside the holes. No border by default, optional.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理位圖（PNG/JPG/WebP），不認 SVG/PDF；輸出固定 300 DPI 的 PNG。
skills.limit_en: Raster only (PNG/JPG/WebP); no SVG/PDF. Outputs fixed 300-DPI PNG, drops EXIF. Sheet mode forces equal width—tall images get center-cropped.
skills.title_en: Stamp maker: real transparent PNG with die-cut edge

skills.name: visit-prep-information-pack
skills.title_zh: 老人看病前，把症狀、藥盒、報告理成一頁紙
skills.tagline_zh: 陪爸媽去醫院最怕問不清、說不明、白跑一趟。它把時間線、要問的話、藥盒照片、報告單都結構化成一頁大字資料包。
skills.tagline_en: Stop blanking at the doctor's. It turns symptom timelines, pill boxes, reports, and your questions into one.
skills.desc_en: 面向老年人及家屬/照護者，整理就醫前後的健康信息：症狀時間線、陪診提問、檢查報告或藥盒照片的 OCR 結構化、健康謠言/健康說法的權威核驗、血壓血糖等慢病日記和一頁就診資料包。用戶提到老人看病準備、陪診、病歷/報告/藥盒整理、家庭健康記錄、健康傳言核驗或需要家屬確認時，即使未明確說“使用 Skill”，也優先使用。默認短句、大字友好、最小隱私；不診斷、不解釋處方、不調整用藥、不決定分診或設定閾值。危急信號優先當地急救服務。
skills.why_zh: 不是簡單問答，而是按就醫動線把零散信息編排成可交付的實體：症狀時間線、陪診提問、OCR 藥盒報告。
skills.why_en: Structured around the care visit flow, not a chatbot. It compiles scattered info into a deliverable one-pager with checkable.
skills.limit_zh: 只做信息整理與核驗，不診斷、不解釋處方、不調藥、不分診、不設閾值；危急信號直接轉當地急救。OCR 依賴照片清晰度。
skills.limit_en: Organizes and verifies only. No diagnosis, prescription advice, triage, or thresholds. OCR needs clear photos; blurry labels may misread—always.
skills.title_en: One-page visit pack: symptoms, meds, reports, questions.

skills.name: nature-writing-studio
skills.title_zh: 657 篇 Nature 原文蒸餾出的學術英語改寫器
skills.tagline_zh: 投 Nature 前，摘要和引言總被批「不夠 native」。它用 657 篇原文逐篇觀察出的語料庫改寫。
skills.tagline_en: Before you submit, your abstract gets flagged 'not native'. This rewrites using patterns from 657 Nature.
skills.desc_en: Rewrite scientific text into Nature Portfolio English using a knowledge base distilled from 657 Nature family papers via per-paper LLM observation (87.6% coverage), now extended with 5 deterministic AI-observation TSVs (gap_transitions / opener_distribution / cross_section_linkers / hedge_verbs / results_discussion_openers) from 412 v3 Nature papers via MiniMax-M3 per-paper observation. Trigger fo
skills.why_zh: 不是通用潤色，是 87.6% 覆蓋率的逐篇觀察知識庫，外加 5 個確定性 TSV（gap 轉換。
skills.why_en: Not generic polishing—a per-paper observation KB with 87.6% coverage, plus 5 deterministic TSVs for gap transitions, openers.
skills.limit_zh: 只改寫科學文本為 Nature Portfolio 風格，不生成新內容；需輸入英文或可翻譯的學術草稿；不處理圖表。
skills.limit_en: Rewrites only scientific text into Nature Portfolio style; no new content generation. Needs English or translatable draft. No figures/references.
skills.title_en: Nature-style English rewriter distilled from 657 papers

skills.name: heritage-records-access-governance
skills.title_zh: 社區說了算的口述史訪問與歸檔流程
skills.tagline_zh: 原住民與少數族群自己掌控口述史、地名、親屬稱謂的採集與開放權限。每個環節都要社區點頭，不點頭就不進入下一步。
skills.tagline_en: Plan, consent, organize, describe, review oral histories with Indigenous & minoritized communities. Every step.
skills.desc_en: Community-governed workflow for Indigenous and minoritized communities to plan, consent, organize, describe, and review oral histories, stories, place names, kinship terms, and cultural lexicon. Use when a community archivist, language worker, elder, narrator, or authorized partner asks to structure notes, draft metadata, map access protocols, prepare a review packet, or maintain a culturally gove
skills.why_zh: 把文化治理權還給社區：從規劃到同意、整理、描述、審查，每一步都有明確關卡，避免外部研究者越俎代庖。
skills.why_en: Returns cultural authority to communities: each phase has explicit gates, preventing outside researchers from overstepping.
skills.limit_zh: 僅適用於社區檔案員、語言工作者、長者或授權夥伴發起的口述史相關任務；不處理非口述史類文檔，也不自動生成最終元數據。
skills.limit_en: Only for oral-history-related tasks initiated by community archivists, language workers, elders, or authorized partners. Won't auto-generate final.
skills.title_en: Community-governed workflow for oral history access &.

skills.name: empathy
skills.title_zh: 動筆前先過一遍人類溝通守則的 AI 助手
skills.tagline_zh: PR、評論、郵件、聊天……凡是要給人看的文字，先讀規則再落筆。省得發出去才後悔，收回來又尷尬。
skills.tagline_en: For PRs, comments, emails, chats—anything a person will read. Loads the rules first, so you don't regret sending.
skills.desc_en: Rules for communicating with humans as an AI agent. Read in full BEFORE composing any text another person will read: PR titles and descriptions, issues, code review replies, comments, discussion summaries, emails, chat and forum posts, commit messages, changelogs. Also before replying when someone responds to you, and before deciding whether to post at all. Do not draft first and check after. Mini
skills.why_zh: 它不是事後檢查，而是前置約束。在起草任何對外文本前強制加載規則，從源頭減少冒犯與誤解。
skills.why_en: Enforces rules before drafting, not after. Cuts friction and faux pas at the source.
skills.limit_zh: 僅約束 AI 生成的對外文本，不覆蓋語音、表情符號或非文字媒介；若你已習慣手動檢查，此技能可能顯得多餘。
skills.limit_en: Text-only; no voice, emoji, or visual media. Redundant if you already self-check every message.
skills.title_en: AI that reads human-communication rules before you write

skills.name: report
skills.title_zh: 漏洞確認後直接產出可提交的 DOCX 報告
skills.tagline_zh: 查重、分層驗證門、固定骨架、Step 式 PoC、真實截圖、語義化命名、放對目錄——從確認到成稿一條龍。
skills.tagline_en: Dedup, layered verification gates, fixed layout, step-style PoC, real screenshots, semantic naming, correct.

Use this whenever creating or amending commits, writing commit messages, opening or updating pull requests or issues, merging, squashing, rebasing, tagging, releasing, or pushing — any git or GitHub write operation — even when the user says nothing
skills.why_zh: 不是事後清理，而是攔截在寫入動作前。它理解 git 全生命週期操作，在用戶沉默時也默認執行。
skills.why_en: Not a cleanup tool—it intercepts before any git write. Covers the full lifecycle, defaults to stripping even when you say.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理 git/github 寫入操作，不碰文件內容本身；若你確實想讓 AI 署名，需顯式配置例外名單。
skills.limit_en: Only affects git/GitHub write ops, never file contents. If you truly want AI credit, you must configure an explicit allowlist—otherwise it strips.
skills.title_en: Git commit hygiene: keep AI authorship out

skills.name: redazione-norme
skills.title_zh: 意大利國家法規起草與修訂助手
skills.tagline_zh: 起草法律、法令、條例時，自動套用意大利現行立法技術規則（1988/400法至2024年DPCM）。
skills.tagline_en: Draft Italian laws, decrees, and regulations with automatic compliance to current legislative drafting rules (Law.
skills.desc_en: Redige e revisiona testi normativi statali italiani secondo le regole di tecnica legislativa vigenti (legge 400/1988, circolari PCM 20 aprile e 2 maggio 2001, direttive PCM 2008 e 2009, legge 196/2009, DPCM 169/2017, DPCM 30 ottobre 2024, legge 167/2025) — disegni di legge, decreti-legge, decreti legislativi, regolamenti, testi unici, novelle, abrogazioni. Da usare quando l'utente chiede di scrive
skills.why_zh: 內置最新立法技術規範（含2024年DPCM與2025年法）。
skills.why_en: Built-in latest drafting rules (incl. DPCM 2024 & Law 2025), handles cross-references in novelle and abrogazioni, ensuring.
skills.limit_zh: 僅覆蓋意大利國家層面規範性文本（法律、法令、條例、統編文本），不含歐盟法規或大區法規；需用戶提供原文或明確修訂指令。
skills.limit_en: Only Italian state-level normative texts (laws, decrees, regulations, T.U.); excludes EU or regional law; requires source text or explicit revision.
skills.title_en: Italian State Norm Drafting & Revision Assistant

skills.name: deepseek-v4-flash-vision-rag
skills.title_zh: 問PDF哪頁答哪頁，連掃描圖紙都認得出
skills.tagline_zh: 掃描版、圖表、圖紙、表格、代碼都能讀，回答直接帶物理頁碼和命中頁原圖。不用再翻幾十頁找依據，它把證據拍在你眼前。
skills.tagline_en: Reads scans, charts, blueprints, tables, code. Every answer cites the physical page and shows the matching.
skills.desc_en: 基於DeepSeek視覺大模型（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp）的PDF深度問答（人式讀文檔 Vision RAG）。當用戶提到 PDF、文檔、資料、報告、論文、電子書、手冊、說明書、圖紙、表格，並想提問、查找、搜索、總結或理解其內容，或問"在哪一頁"、"引用原文"、要頁面截圖時，使用本skill。支持掃描版、圖表、圖紙、表格、代碼的視覺理解；回答帶物理頁碼引用，並把命中頁原圖展示給用戶。
skills.why_zh: 視覺模型直接看頁面，不是先OCR再檢索。頁碼是物理頁碼不是PDF內部序號。
skills.why_en: Vision model reads the page directly—no fragile OCR-then-search pipeline. Cites physical page numbers and shows the actual page.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃PDF文件，Word/網頁需先轉PDF。單次問答限一份文檔，跨文檔對比不支持。回答依賴DeepSeek視覺模型。
skills.limit_en: PDF only—convert Word/web first. One document per session, no cross-file comparison. Requires DeepSeek vision API; useless offline or when API is.
skills.title_en: Ask PDFs, get page + screenshot answers

skills.name: skill-library-pruner
skills.title_zh: 先盤點再動手，刪技能前會問你三遍的整理師
skills.tagline_zh: 技能庫長到 200 個、一半沒碰過？它先列清單標出從未使用的，再逐個禁用試運行。
skills.tagline_en: Too many skills? It inventories all, flags unused & duplicates, then asks before each delete. Nothing vanishes.
skills.desc_en: Read-first, reversible workflow for pruning an overgrown Claude Code skills library. Inventories every skill, spots duplicates and dead weight, reports what has not been used, disables safely, then deletes only what goes unmissed. Use when the user wants to prune, declutter, audit, consolidate, or shrink their skills, or says "I have too many skills", "clean up my skills", "which of my skills are
skills.why_zh: 別人直接刪，它先禁用一週。用「未使用時長」排序而非文件名，逼你面對真實習慣，而不是憑印象砍錯寶貝。
skills.why_en: Unlike delete-first tools, it separates disabling from deleting: quarantine first, confirm you don't miss it, then purge.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理 Claude Code 的 skills 目錄，不碰插件或全局配置；需要你手動確認每個禁用項，不能無人值守。
skills.limit_en: Only handles Claude Code's skills folder; ignores global config or non-project skills. Outputs report + disable/delete actions; no backup—ensure.
skills.title_en: Skill-library pruner that inventories before it deletes

skills.name: cn-compliance-guard
skills.title_zh: 上架前掃一遍，廣告法違禁詞當場標紅
skills.tagline_zh: 200+違禁詞、6類法律風險、5大平臺SEO規則一次查完。不只告訴你哪裡違規，還給出能安全替換的說法。
skills.tagline_en: Scans 200+ banned words, 6 legal risk types, 5 platform SEO rules. Flags violations and suggests safe.
skills.desc_en: Scan Chinese text for 200+ banned words across 6 legal categories (廣告法/消費者權益保護法), check SEO compliance for 5 platforms (百度/小紅書/抖音/淘寶/京東), and provide safe replacement suggestions. Detects 絕對化用語, 醫療效果承諾, 虛假宣傳, 金融承諾, 誘導消費, 比較廣告. Use when: checking Chinese marketing copy for legal compliance, reviewing product descriptions for advertising law violations, auditing content before publishing on Chinese
skills.why_zh: 把廣告法、消保法的抽象條款編譯成可執行的檢查清單，連平臺SEO偏好也納入同一套規則。
skills.why_en: Turns vague ad-law clauses into an executable checklist, merging platform SEO quirks into one pass—no more guessing what.
skills.limit_zh: 只認簡體中文營銷文案，不覆蓋合同、公告等非廣告文體；替換建議基於通用合規，不保證特定平臺審核必過。
skills.limit_en: Simplified-Chinese marketing copy only; not for contracts or notices. Rewrites are generic, not platform-guaranteed. Needs internet for latest rules.
skills.title_en: Pre-publish scan for China ad-law banned words

skills.name: format-agent
skills.title_zh: AI只出規則、代碼動手改的格式排版工
skills.tagline_zh: 把亂糟糟的 docx 按你的格式規範重排。AI 不碰文檔，只產出兩份 JSON；所有修改由確定性代碼完成。
skills.tagline_en: Reformat messy docx against your spec. AI never touches the file—it outputs two JSONs; deterministic code applies.
skills.desc_en: 通用文檔格式排版。當用戶給一份"格式規範"（自然語言規範文字，或排好版的 Word 模板）加一份格式混亂的 docx，要求按規範重排時使用。AI 只產出兩個 JSON（格式規則 FormatSpec、段落角色 RoleMap），所有文檔修改由確定性代碼完成，輸出可繼續編輯的命名樣式文檔、修訂模式文檔和修改對照報告。
skills.why_zh: AI 幻覺不碰正文。規則與執行徹底分離：格式規則和段落角色先落成 JSON，再由代碼逐條執行。
skills.why_en: No AI hallucination touches your text. Rules and execution are fully separated: spec and roles become JSON first, then code.
skills.limit_zh: 只接受 docx 輸入，且必須同時提供格式規範（文字說明或排好版的 Word 模板）。產出物是命名樣式文檔。
skills.limit_en: Input must be docx plus a style spec (text or a formatted Word file). Outputs are named-style doc, tracked-changes doc, and a diff report—no content.
skills.title_en: AI writes rules, code does the reformatting

skills.name: youtube-clipper
skills.title_zh: YouTube 長視頻先切章再剪段，字幕同步燒進畫面
skills.tagline_zh: 你刷到一條 40 分鐘訪談，只想留 3 分鐘金句。它自動下載、按分鐘切章節，你點選片段，字幕翻譯、燒錄。
skills.tagline_en: Got a 40-min interview but only want the 3-min gold? It auto-downloads, chapterizes by minute, then you.
skills.desc_en: YouTube 視頻智能剪輯工具。下載視頻和字幕，AI 分析生成精細章節（幾分鐘級別）， 用戶選擇片段後自動剪輯、翻譯字幕為中英雙語、燒錄字幕到視頻，並生成總結文案。 使用場景：當用戶需要剪輯 YouTube 視頻、生成短視頻片段、製作雙語字幕版本時。 關鍵詞：視頻剪輯、YouTube、字幕翻譯、雙語字幕、視頻下載、clip video
skills.why_zh: 章節粒度到分鐘級，不是粗切；字幕翻譯和燒錄在同一流水線裡完成，不用你導出後再找工具二次加工。選完片段。
skills.why_en: Chapter granularity is minute-level, not coarse cuts; subtitle translation and burn-in happen in one pipeline—no exporting and.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃 YouTube 鏈接，需能訪問 YouTube；依賴 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 預裝。
skills.limit_en: YouTube links only, needs network access to YouTube; requires ffmpeg & yt-dlp preinstalled. Translation needs source subtitles; no subs means.
skills.title_en: Clip YouTube by chapter, burn bilingual subs in

skills.name: ayi-nonviolent-communication
skills.title_zh: 把指責翻譯成需要的長頸鹿語言翻譯官
skills.tagline_zh: 吵架前、回消息前、做決定前，先過一遍這架翻譯機。它不教你說漂亮話，而是把指責、委屈、糾結拆回普世需要，讓話能落地。
skills.tagline_en: Before you snap back, text back, or decide—run it through this translator. It doesn't polish words; it unpacks.
skills.desc_en: 馬歇爾·盧森堡《非暴力溝通》(NVC/善意溝通/長頸鹿語言) 的可執行工具箱。核心引擎是把任何信息(自己的或他人的)翻譯成"觀察—感受—需要—請求" (Observation-Feeling-Need-Request) 四要素,重新與普世"需要"連結。覆蓋五類用法:① 決策/自我教練(理清自己的需要再行動); ② 話術改寫(把指責/評判式表達改成 NVC 表達); ③ 同理傾聽(聽見對方話語背後的感受和需要); ④ 衝突調解/復盤(區分需要vs策略,設計滿足各方的方案); ⑤ 以馬歇爾的語氣產出內容。當用戶要"幫我想想怎麼說/這話該怎麼回""我該不該做這個決定/理一理我現在的情緒""改一下這條消息別那麼衝" "他這麼說我該怎麼回應/怎麼勸""化解一段衝突/調解吵架/復盤一次難談話""表達感謝/反饋/批評""我好生氣/好委屈/好內疚怎麼辦", 或提到 非暴力溝通 / NVC / 善意溝通 /
skills.why_zh: 不是話術模板庫，而是一臺可執行的翻譯引擎：輸入任何帶情緒的原話，輸出結構化的四要素。
skills.why_en: Not a phrasebook—an executable engine. Feed it any emotionally loaded line; it returns structured OFNR and separates needs from.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理語言層面的重構，不替代心理諮詢或危機干預。若對方處於嚴重心理危機或雙方有暴力史，它不會判斷安全邊界。
skills.limit_en: Language reframing only; not a substitute for therapy or crisis intervention. In cases of severe distress or violence history, it won't assess.
skills.title_en: NVC translator: turns blame into needs

skills.name: app-ui-ux-best-practices
skills.title_zh: 先拒寫設計稿，拿產品證據校準五個刻度再出規範
skills.tagline_zh: 先從產品證據推出五個檔位（響度/成色/密度/重量/嚴肅度），再出設計規範、token、組件準則——每個檔位都要給出處，不許憑習慣設。
skills.tagline_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
skills.desc_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
skills.why_zh: 它有一條含糊詞防火牆：premium、精緻、剋制、高級感一律不許當理由，必須換算成飽和度、間距、圓角、動效幅度。
skills.why_en: A vague-word firewall: premium, refined, elegant, tasteful are never justifications; they must become saturation, spacing, radius and motion numbers.
skills.limit_zh: 它出的是設計規範和單頁預覽，不是整套前端工程。檔位一旦從證據推定，後面所有步驟都跟著走，你想中途換風格得從證據改起。只有一件 skill，正文很長、很吃上下文。
skills.limit_en: Outputs design specs and a single preview page, not a full front-end. Long document, context-hungry. One skill only.
skills.title_en: Evidence-first design specs: calibrate 5 dials before.

skills.name: ResumeSkills
skills.title_zh: 只改動詞和數字就過篩的簡歷潤色師
skills.tagline_zh: 投了 50 份沒回音？不是你不配，是簡歷沒撞對 ATS 的鐘。這套技能把求職拆成可執行的每一步。
skills.tagline_en: 50 applications, zero callbacks? It's not you—it's your resume missing ATS keywords. This suite turns job hunting.
skills.desc_en: A collection of AI agent skills focused on resume optimization, job applications, and career development. Built for job seekers, career changers, and professionals who want Claude Code to help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview prep, and strategic job search.
skills.why_zh: 不是單個提示詞，而是按求職流程分模塊的技能集合：簡歷重寫、ATS 掃描、面試模擬各司其職。
skills.why_en: Not one mega-prompt—a modular pipeline. Rewrite, ATS-scan, and interview-prep skills each do one job, callable solo or chained.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋求職文本與面試話術，不生成職位匹配度報告，也不替你做薪資談判。需要你已有目標 JD 或簡歷原文。
skills.limit_en: Covers resume text & interview scripts only—no job-match scoring, no salary negotiation. Needs a target JD or existing resume; vague verbal input.

install.note: clone 下來，挑你要的那件複製進 ~/.claude/skills/。這是一個合集，沒有「裝它」這個動作。

skills.title_en: Resume editor that fixes verbs & numbers to pass ATS filters

skills.name: goldie
skills.title_zh: 重放 App 操作錄屏，套上真實商店頁邊框和文案
skills.tagline_zh: 回放 argent 流程錄屏，給截圖套機身邊框、配底色和文案，出 4~5 張成品加一段預覽視頻，本地起個 studio 按真實商店頁排給你看。
skills.tagline_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
skills.desc_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
skills.why_zh: 預覽視頻它堅持交原始錄屏不加邊框字幕——因為蘋果就是這麼要求的，它沒替你「美化」成會被打回的東西。
skills.why_en: It insists the preview video stays a plain screen recording — because Apple requires that — instead of prettifying it into something that gets rejected.
skills.limit_zh: 要在這個 App 自己的倉裡跑，且要有 iOS 模擬器或安卓模擬器。挑哪幾屏值得營銷、寫流程、寫文案還是你的活，它只負責跑和渲。studio 起在 localhost:4321，視頻在後臺渲。
skills.limit_en: Run it from the mobile app's own repo with a simulator available. Choosing which screens to market, authoring the flows and writing the copy stay yours.
skills.title_en: Replay app flows, framed in a real store page mockup

skills.name: aicss
skills.title_zh: AI 對話界面不重造輪子，現成思考態與流式輸出組件
skills.tagline_zh: 思考中、流式輸出這類 AI 會話專用的界面部件，npm 裝 React 版，或用 CLI 取 React／Vue／Svelte 源碼直接落進你的項目。
skills.tagline_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
skills.desc_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
skills.why_zh: AI 產品的界面反覆要造同一批零件，這裡把它們做成了能直接取走的成品，還帶在線預覽。
skills.why_en: Every AI product rebuilds the same handful of chat-UI parts; these are finished, with live previews.
skills.limit_zh: 它不是 SKILL.md 形態的 agent skill，裝不進 agent，是 npm 包和 CLI，要你自己寫代碼接。免費組件在 npm 上；Pro 組件不在，要用 CLI 配 AICSS_TOKEN，那是付費的。文檔站是閉源的，這個倉只是包源碼。
skills.limit_en: Not a SKILL.md agent skill — an npm package and CLI you wire up yourself. Free components on npm; Pro ones need a paid AICSS_TOKEN.
skills.title_en: AI chat UI parts: thinking states & streaming output, no.

skills.name: photo-chromatic-abstraction-style-1
skills.title_zh: 只留 1~5 個源圖色，把照片譯成色塊記憶卡
skills.tagline_zh: 照片信息太多？它只留色塊和1-5個剋制的高光點。適合色彩構成練習、色卡轉譯，或你只想記住畫面的顏色而非細節時。
skills.tagline_en: Too much detail in your photo? It keeps only flat color fields plus 1-5 restrained accents. For palette-memory.
skills.desc_en: Translate an uploaded or local photograph into a color-first chromatic-memory abstraction (Style 1) built from adaptive flat fields and 1-5 restrained, source-derived accents. Use for palette-memory composition, color-weight studies, minimalist color-block translation, 色塊抽象、照片色彩記憶、色彩構成、照片色卡轉譯，or explicit Style-1 requests where broad color hierarchy matters more than subject placement. Do not use w
skills.why_zh: 自適應平場分區，不靠邊緣檢測或主體識別——顏色層級決定一切，高光點從原圖推導而非隨機點綴。
skills.why_en: Adaptive flat-field segmentation, not edge detection or subject recognition—color hierarchy drives everything. Accents are.
skills.limit_zh: 只做風格1的色塊抽象，不做構圖重構或細節保留。輸入需為單張照片（本地或上傳），不支持多圖合成。產物為靜態圖。
skills.limit_en: Only Style-1 color-block abstraction; no composition reshaping or detail retention. Single photo input only (local or upload), no multi-image.
skills.title_en: Photo to 1–5-color memory blocks, not a copy

skills.name: personal-reflector
skills.title_zh: 不餵雞湯只拆模式的自我復盤鏡
skills.tagline_zh: 當焦慮、自我懷疑、關係困局反覆出現，它不給你雞湯，而是幫你照見舊系統如何運作、新系統卡在哪，讓轉型期不再原地打轉。
skills.tagline_en: When anxiety, self-doubt, or relationship loops repeat, it skips the platitudes—showing how your old system runs.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user discusses personal emotions, anxiety, self-doubt, behavior patterns, relationships, career identity confusion, or life direction. Triggers on: 焦慮、難受、懷疑自己、模式、重複、關係、職業身份、方向迷茫、轉型期、恢復期、意義感、新舊系統交替。
skills.why_zh: 它不分析你，而是鏡像你——把情緒事件拆成可觀察的模式與觸發點，像一面會提問的鏡子。
skills.why_en: It doesn't analyze you—it mirrors you, breaking emotional events into observable patterns and triggers, like a mirror that asks.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋個人內心議題（情緒、身份、方向），不處理外部決策或人際衝突的具體解法；產物是結構化反思而非行動方案。
skills.limit_en: Only covers inner issues (emotions, identity, direction), not external decisions or conflict solutions; output is structured reflection, not action.
skills.title_en: A self-reflection mirror that dissects patterns, not.

skills.name: threejs-animation

skills.why_zh: 上面保住照片，下面用線重新說一遍。

skills.name: continuity

skills.tagline_zh: 怕戰力越級、傷勢自愈、身份忽爆忽藏？它逐章核對時間線+資源+人物行為，揪出和前文矛盾的每一處，直接給改法。
skills.tagline_en: Scared of power creep, healing plot holes, or identity flips? It cross-checks timeline, resources, and behavior.
skills.desc_en: 中文網文長篇連貫性與邏輯檢查。當用戶寫長篇怕"前後矛盾/寫到一百章崩了/設定漂移"、要查時間線亂不亂、人物行為合不合理、資源憑空變、身份忽暴忽藏、傷勢沒延續、戰力越級、或要對一卷/全書做邏輯體檢時使用。逐章核對六條邏輯鏈+時間線，揪出和前文/檔案的矛盾並給改法。
skills.why_zh: 不是泛泛提建議，而是拿六條固定邏輯鏈（時間/資源/傷勢/戰力/身份/行為）當尺子。
skills.why_en: No vague advice—it runs six fixed logic chains (time, resources, injuries, power, identity, behavior) against each chapter's.
skills.limit_zh: 只認中文網文敘事（玄幻/都市/科幻等），不認劇本、大綱、非連續章節片段；需要你提供前文或設定檔案才能比對。

skills.title_en: Distill motion-poster shots into copy-paste prompts

skills.name: as-told-to
skills.title_zh: 只記你說過的話，不替你補半句的人生訪談錄
skills.tagline_zh: 一場一場地採訪你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原樣留檔，另出一份下次接著問的筆記；成不成書隨你，檔案先歸你自己。
skills.tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.

skills.why_zh: 不許遞一個細節讓老人點頭確認：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」進待核清單，正文寫「我不確定」。

skills.limit_zh: 它只採訪在場的本人，不替不在場的人寫傳記，也拒絕改寫成簡歷、領英簡介或創始人故事。情緒一上來就全停：只給「留在這裡／換話題／今天到這」三個選項，一個追問都不許有。倉庫 dev/ 目錄裡抄了同行的整份 skill 當對照，安裝時別一起拷進去。
skills.limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
skills.title_en: Life-story interviewer that writes only your words

skills.name: travel-guidebook
