skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 八步把模糊問題走成一份可引用的調研報告
skills.tagline_zh: 想調研一個話題，AI 卻給你一篇維基摘要？這套八步法逼它先拆問題再找料，產出的是能拿去做決策的報告，不是概述。
skills.tagline_en: Wang Shuyi's eight-step research methodology — turns a vague topic into a high-quality research report; "research this for me" triggers it.
skills.desc_en: 深度調研方法論（8步法）：將模糊主題轉化為高質量調研報告。 觸發詞：/deep-research、深度調研、幫我調研、調研一下、對比分析 注意：如果用戶需要的是可視化圖譜而非報告，請使用 research-to-diagram skill。
skills.why_zh: 作者高校教師出身、常年教研究方法，這八步是真在帶學生做研究時用的那套，不是拍腦袋編的流程。
skills.why_en: By a university teacher who has taught research method for years — these eight steps come from actually supervising research, not from a whiteboard.

install.note_zh: 兩件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 裡都叫 deep-research —— 生態是扁平命名空間，同名就會互相靜默覆蓋。這裡加了作者前綴消歧，跟作者倉庫裡的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 產物寫死在 ~/Downloads/research/<主題>/，打包成 ~/outcome.tar.gz。Step 6.5 硬卡：必須另起獨立 Agent 複核事實與推導，派不出子代理就卡住。全程靠 WebSearch。
skills.limit_en: Working dir is hardcoded to ~/Downloads/research/<topic>/, packed into ~/outcome.tar.gz. Step 6.5 is BLOCKING: a separate Agent must audit the fact cards and reasoning, so no sub-agent means no report. Needs live WebSearch.
skills.title_en: 8 steps from vague question to citable report

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow

skills.why_zh: 固定水彩畫風加角色設定圖，保證每頁都是同一個小孩，再用你自己的聲音朗讀，出一個能發出去的文件。

Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.

skills.name: human-writing
skills.title_zh: 按活人那套改中文長文
skills.tagline_zh: 知乎帖、人物故事、行業文，先刪腔再寫
skills.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
skills.desc_en: 通用中文創作與改稿 Skill。用於知乎回答、論壇長帖、公眾號文章、博客、評論、人物故事、歷史敘事、新聞與行業解讀、科普、教程、評測、個人敘事、小說、故事、對白、口播和演講稿。默認寫成一個見過事、查過材料、願意把來龍去脈講清楚的人在說話，重點保留中文互聯網長回答與長帖的活人感和自然中文韻律，避免空泛的機構腔、喊口號式演說腔、營銷腔和模型腔。非虛構長文先檢查材料夠不夠，材料不足時研究、追問或縮短，絕不用重複解釋灌字數。現實內容額外核驗事實、引語、數據與用戶親歷，虛構內容可以創造人物、場景、對白、心理與情節。成稿正文嚴禁冒號、破折號、“不是……而是……”及同類翻案句，並清除商業黑話和模型慣用黑話。不創建作者畫像、個人規則庫或個人寫作 Skill。
skills.why_zh: 卡茲克這件賣的是中文現場的人味，不是通用潤色按鈕。
skills.why_en: Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.
skills.limit_zh: 不是短視頻口播稿。要英文明信片、要公文，另裝。
skills.limit_en: If a nonfiction piece cannot list five concrete pieces of material, it refuses to write long and caps you near 600 characters. Em dashes, signposting colons and "not A but B" framing are banned. check_prose.py checks hard bans only.
skills.title_en: Installs a voice instead of banning AI words

skills.name: video-clip-stitching
skills.title_zh: 接縫診斷師：專治AI分段影片的卡頓與重複
skills.tagline_zh: 把Dreamina、Runway、Seedance的01/02/03段接成順滑一支。不靠猜——切點公式、接縫分類。
skills.tagline_en: Splice Dreamina/Runway/Seedance segments into one smooth cut. No guessing—cut formulas, seam taxonomy, and 3.
skills.desc_en: 把多段 AI 生成的影片（Dreamina、Runway、Higgsfield、Seedance 等）串成一支，並診斷接縫問題。當使用者要把 01／02／03 這類分段生成的片接起來、抱怨兩段之間「卡住」「重複」「不順」「有 overlap」、或要驗收生成素材規格時，一定要用這個 skill。也適用於任何「拿前一段的尾幀去續生下一段」的工作流——那種接法必然在接縫留下緩啟動死水，而且容器標記的幀率經常騙人。不要自己重推判準：切點公式、接縫分類法、三個 ffmpeg 地雷，這裡每一條都是實際撞出來的。
skills.why_zh: 它不重新發明判準，而是把實際撞出來的接縫規律直接固化：容器幀率會騙人。
skills.why_en: It doesn't reinvent criteria—it bakes in field-hardened seam rules: container FPS lies, tail-frame continuation always leaves.
skills.limit_zh: 只處理視頻拼接與接縫診斷，不負責調色、轉碼、字幕或音頻修復。需要ffmpeg已安裝。
skills.limit_en: Only handles stitching & seam diagnosis, not color, transcoding, subs, or audio repair. Requires ffmpeg. Formulas assume AI-segmented generation.
skills.title_en: Stitch doctor for AI clips: fixes jumps & repeats

skills.name: skills-janitor
skills.title_zh: 給你裝的技能庫做體檢和減法
skills.tagline_zh: 裝得越多上下文越擠，還不知道哪個在偷偷吃 token、哪個藏著提示注入。它左滑扔掉浪費的、掃風險、給誠實的 token 賬單。
skills.tagline_en: A health check for your installed skills — swipe away context wasters, scan for prompt injection, get an honest token bill. It calls itself Tinder for skills.
skills.desc_en: Tinder for your Claude Code skills. Swipe away what wastes context, scan for prompt injection, get honest token costs. 6 commands, zero dependencies, Claude Code + Codex.
skills.why_zh: 這個生態罕見的「減法」工具：裝得多不等於裝得好，它同時管省上下文、防注入、看清成本。
skills.why_en: More installed isn't better: it handles context waste, injection risk and real cost at once — a rare subtractive tool in this ecosystem.

install.note: clone 下來，挑你要的那件複製進 ~/.claude/skills/。這是一個合集，沒有「裝它」這個動作。

skills.limit_zh: 它會真動手刪：左滑就把那個 MCP server 從配置文件裡移除，只留一個帶時間戳的 .bak。判斷依據是本機會話記錄裡的調用次數——剛裝沒多久的 skill 天然顯示成「沒用過」，容易誤殺。安全掃描作者寫明是啟發式。
skills.limit_en: It actually deletes: swipe left and the MCP server is removed from your config file, leaving a timestamped .bak. Its verdict comes from call counts in your local transcripts, so anything installed recently reads as 'never used'. The security scan is explicitly heuristic.
skills.title_en: Swipe left on the skills quietly billing you tokens

skills.name: seedance-debugger
skills.title_zh: 視頻里人臉飄了先別刪，它給你換提示詞的根因
skills.tagline_zh: 人物變雙胞胎、字幕亂入、風格漂移、結尾爆音——12 類故障它不修視頻，只修你手裡那句提示詞，改完重跑就穩。
skills.tagline_en: Twin faces, stray subtitles, style drift, end noise—it fixes the prompt, not the footage, across 12 Seedance.
skills.desc_en: 診斷 Seedance 2.0 生成視頻時出現的常見問題（人物 ID 漂移/雙胞胎/字幕/Logo/風格漂移/延長跳變/畫質劣化/特效不對/中文發音/音色不準/結尾噪音 等 12 類），定位根因並給出修復後的提示詞。用於"我的提示詞生成出來不對"、"視頻裡出現奇怪的字幕"、"人臉不像參考圖"、"出現兩個一樣的人物"、"風格變了"、"怎麼修這個提示詞"等觸發場景。
skills.why_zh: 不是籠統說'加強一致性'，而是按故障類型拆解到具體參數與措辭，告訴你哪句話導致 ID 漂移。
skills.why_en: No vague 'improve consistency'—it maps each failure to specific prompt phrases and settings, so edits target the actual cause.
skills.limit_zh: 只診斷 Seedance 2.0 的提示詞問題，不處理其他視頻模型；需要你提供原提示詞和故障截圖/片段；它給修復建議。
skills.limit_en: Only for Seedance 2.0 prompt issues; requires your original prompt plus a screenshot/clip; suggests fixes but doesn't generate video.
skills.title_en: Fix Seedance 2.0 glitches by root cause, not guesswork
skills.cover_note: 和同倉母件同一張 README 圖，同圖四張擺一起像刷屏，只留母件

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.title_zh: 生成手繪白板風格的示意圖
skills.tagline_zh: 講思路時精確框圖顯得冷，手繪草圖更讓人願意看。它出真正的 Excalidraw 文件，畫完你還能自己拖著改。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
skills.desc_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.
skills.why_zh: 產物是可編輯源文件而不是截圖——這一點決定了它能進日常工作流，而不只是配圖。
skills.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.
skills.limit_zh: 必做的渲染校驗要用 uv 裝 Playwright 和 Chromium。正文禁止寫腳本生成、禁止轉交別的 agent，只能一段段手敲 JSON，再渲染—看圖—改，通常來回 2-4 輪。 隨件的渲染模板從 esm.sh 拉 excalidraw，傳遞依賴現在 404、腳本會等到超時；釘版本到 0.18.0 才渲得出來。
skills.limit_en: The mandatory validation step renders through uv, Playwright and Chromium. The skill forbids writing a generator script or handing the job to a coding agent: you hand-write JSON section by section, then loop render-view-fix 2-4 times. Its render template pulls excalidraw from esm.sh; a transitive dependency 404s today and the script hangs until timeout. Pinning 0.18.0 fixes it.
skills.title_en: Generated diagrams that look hand-drawn and stay editable
skills.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/coleam00/excalidraw-diagram-skill; python -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install playwright && venv/bin/playwright install chromium; 【必須打一處補丁】r`。我造的 demo（圖的內容我自己寫：Agent Skill 的漸進式披露加載流程，四步 + 一段真實 frontmatter + 一條提醒）

skills.name: dnd
skills.title_zh: 一個人也能玩的 D&D 地下城主
skills.tagline_zh: 跑團最難的是湊人和一個好 DM。它管戰役、角色卡、戰鬥輪次和 NPC，還帶可選的影院式畫面，一個人也能沉浸開團。
skills.tagline_en: An on-call D&D 5e Dungeon Master — persistent campaigns, character sheets, combat tracking and NPCs, with an optional cinematic display. Solo-play ready.
skills.desc_en: v2.4.0 · Dungeon Master assistant for running persistent D&D 5e campaigns. Handles campaign creation/loading, character management, combat tracking, NPC generation, dice rolling, and session state — all persisted across sessions. Invoke with /dm:dnd followed by a subcommand, or just speak naturally once a campaign is loaded.
skills.why_zh: 它補上的是 DM 這個最難替代的位置，規則和狀態全託管，所以單人玩不塌。
skills.why_en: The hard part of tabletop is a good DM and a full table; this fills the DM seat — rules, campaign and NPCs managed for solo immersion.
skills.limit_zh: 戰役數據全在本機 ~/.claude/dnd，換臺機器就從零開。隨包只有 5e SRD 數據集，跑正式模組得你自己導入書。影院畫面是本地/局域網起的 Flask 面板。默認 roll_mode 是玩家自己擲骰，它不替你的 PC 代擲。
skills.limit_en: Campaign data lives locally under ~/.claude/dnd - a new machine starts empty. Only the 5e SRD dataset ships; published modules you import yourself. The cinematic display is a local/LAN Flask app. Default roll_mode never auto-rolls your PC.
skills.title_en: A dungeon master for a table of one

skills.name: diagram
skills.title_zh: 自動選對圖表類型再畫出來
skills.tagline_zh: 多數人卡在「該用泳道圖還是時序圖」，不是不會畫。它先按需求選型，再從 29 種裡出符合規範的 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
skills.desc_en: 專業圖表生成技能：根據需求自動選擇合適的圖表類型，生成符合設計規範的 PNG 圖表。 覆蓋 29 種圖表：結構圖（流程圖、泳道圖、時序圖、架構圖、狀態圖、ER圖、類圖、思維導圖、甘特圖、Kanban、Git Graph 等） 和統計圖（柱狀圖、折線圖、餅圖、雷達圖、熱力圖、散點圖、桑基圖、漏斗圖、瀑布圖、矩形樹圖、柱線混合圖等）。 統一工具：HTML/SVG + 內聯 JS 布局計算。ER/類圖使用 ELKjs 布局引擎。 所有圖表遵循統一的設計規範（配色/字體/組件/間距），風格現代簡潔。 支持三種輸出：PNG（默認）、HTML（富文檔嵌入）、DSL（Mermaid 文本，嵌入 MD 文檔）。 觸發詞：畫圖、畫一個、生成圖表、流程圖、架構圖、時序圖、柱狀圖、對比圖、關係圖。 即使用戶沒有說"畫圖"，只要需求中涉及可視化展示（流程、架構、數據對比、關係），都應觸發此技能。 被 deep-r
skills.why_zh: 先選型後出圖這個順序，比丟給你一堆模板實用得多。
skills.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.
skills.limit_zh: 出 PNG 必須跑 scripts/capture.py 和 bridge.py（內部調 Playwright），正文禁止你手動截圖。雷達、熱力、散點、漏斗、瀑布不支持 Mermaid 文本輸出，只能留 PNG。
skills.limit_en: PNGs only come out of scripts/capture.py and bridge.py, which drive Playwright internally — screenshotting by hand is forbidden. Radar, heatmap, scatter, funnel and waterfall get no Mermaid text output, only PNG.
skills.title_en: Decides which of 29 diagram types you actually meant

skills.name: obsidian-cli
skills.title_zh: 在 Obsidian 庫裡搜、寫、改、查，不用開編輯
skills.tagline_zh: 筆記都在 Obsidian 裡，AI 卻看不見。裝上它 agent 能直接讀寫筆記、搜索、改屬性和任務——作者就是 Obsidian 的 CEO。
skills.tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
skills.desc_en: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI to read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, properties, and more. Also supports plugin and theme development with commands to reload plugins, run JavaScript, capture errors, take screenshots, and inspect the DOM. Use when the user asks to interact with their Obsidian vault, manage notes, search vault content, perform vault operations from
skills.why_zh: 一手權威：沒人比作者更懂這個庫的數據模型，比任何第三方封裝都可靠。
skills.why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.
skills.limit_zh: 要裝 obsidian 命令行，而且 Obsidian 必須開著，關掉就全斷。命令清單以 obsidian help 為準，這裡只列了常用幾條。不寫 vault= 時動的是最近聚焦的那個庫。
skills.limit_en: Requires the obsidian CLI and a running Obsidian instance; close the app and everything stops. The command list here is partial, with `obsidian help` as the authority. Without vault=, commands act on whichever vault was focused last.
skills.title_en: Search, write, edit your Obsidian vault from the CLI

skills.name: claude-to-im
skills.title_zh: 從手機指揮電腦裡跑著的 agent
skills.tagline_zh: 長任務要跑一小時，你卻得出門。把會話橋到 Telegram、飛書、微信，手機上發一句就能遠程派活，幹完還推給你。
skills.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
skills.desc_en: Bridge THIS Claude Code or Codex session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ, or WeChat so the user can chat with Claude from their phone. Use for: setting up, starting, stopping, or diagnosing the claude-to-im bridge daemon; forwarding Claude replies to a messaging app; any phrase like "claude-to-im", "bridge", "消息推送", "消息轉發", "橋接", "連上飛書", "手機上看claude", "啟動後臺服務", "診斷", "查看日誌", "配置". Subcommand
skills.why_zh: 歸藏出品，解決的是真痛點：agent 的時間和人的時間從此不用綁在一起。
skills.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.
skills.limit_zh: 本機得一直開著：橋是常駐 Node 進程，裝完還要在 skill 目錄 npm install 和 build。微信只能掃碼綁一個號，沒有內聯授權按鈕和流式預覽，語音只收微信自己轉的文字。飛書要兩輪發版加管理員審批。
skills.limit_en: Your machine must stay up: the bridge is a resident Node daemon, and its dir needs npm install plus build. WeChat is QR-login, one account only, no inline permission buttons or streaming, voice only via WeChat's own transcript.
skills.title_en: Runs on your desk, takes orders from your phone

skills.name: aso-appstore-screenshots
skills.title_zh: 從代碼反推賣點生成 App Store 截圖
skills.tagline_zh: 獨立開發者最不擅長又最影響下載量的就是商店截圖。它先讀你的代碼庫找出核心賣點，再生成 ASO 優化的展示圖。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
skills.desc_en: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots by analyzing your app's codebase, discovering core benefits, and creating ASO-optimized screenshot images using Nano Banana Pro.
skills.why_zh: 從代碼反推賣點，比對著空白頁想文案聰明——素材來自產品本身而不是想像。
skills.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.
skills.limit_zh: 檢測不到 Gemini MCP（npm i -g gemini-mcp）它就直接停手不生成；裁切那步調的是 macOS 專有的 sips。尺寸只給 iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 三種，沒有 iPad，模擬器截圖還得你自己拍。 compose.py 把字體寫死成 /Library/Fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Black.otf，macOS 不自帶、缺了直接崩沒兜底；第二段還要付費模型。
skills.limit_en: It refuses to generate unless the Gemini MCP server (npm i -g gemini-mcp) is present, and the crop/resize step shells out to macOS-only sips. Ships iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 sizes only, no iPad — and you supply the simulator screenshots yourself. compose.py hardcodes an SF Pro font path macOS does not ship; it crashes with no fallback. Stage 2 also needs a paid model.
skills.title_en: Reads your source code to write App Store screenshots

skills.name: translate-book
skills.title_zh: 整本書拆給多個分身並行翻譯，再拼回原排版
skills.tagline_zh: 一本書幾十萬字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用並行子 agent 分塊同時翻，保留原書排版，輸出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
skills.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
skills.desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
skills.why_zh: 並行是關鍵：把幾小時壓到幾十分鐘，而且排版不散——這才讓「翻整本書」從設想變成可做的事。
skills.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.
skills.limit_zh: 本機要有 python3 和 pandoc，DOCX/EPUB/PDF 還得裝 Calibre，缺了只剩 HTML。默認放 8 個子 agent 併發，整本書的 token 你自己付；術語表只從 5 個抽樣塊裡提。
skills.limit_en: Needs python3 and pandoc locally; DOCX/EPUB/PDF conversions require Calibre, otherwise you only get HTML. Default 8 parallel sub-agents, so the whole book is billed as tokens, and the glossary is extracted from only 5 sampled chunks.
skills.title_en: Translate whole books via parallel sub-agents, rebuild.

skills.name: math-modeling

skills.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
skills.desc_en: 當用戶要求數學建模、建模競賽、建模分析、代碼求解、結果可視化或生成數學建模論文時使用。支持完整三階段流程、單獨執行任一角色，以及在關鍵節點使用獨立 Subagent 進行階段內質檢；默認只啟用質檢 Subagent，用戶可明確選擇額外協作。
skills.why_zh: 按競賽真實節奏設計的，不是把「數學建模」當學科名詞做個通用助手。

skills.title_en: A three-day contest team with its own QA critic

skills.tagline_en: A 55K-word, 908-source, 19-playbook email-marketing skill — install it and your agent becomes an email consultant, from automation to diagnostics.

skills.why_en: Staggering density (55K words, 908 sources), not hand-waving; in email marketing where details decide outcomes, a thick knowledge base is real muscle.

skills.title_en: 908 sources of email marketing, installed as one consultant

skills.name: punk-ip-article-illustrations

skills.limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
skills.title_en: Lock the character look first, then illustrate every.

skills.name: university-exam-prep
skills.title_zh: 對著真實課本和考綱突擊複習
skills.tagline_zh: 考的是老師的 PPT 和課本，AI 卻按通用知識給你講。它強制你先傳真材料，再用蘇格拉底式提問帶你想，不灌答案。
skills.tagline_en: Built for textbook-and-slides exams — it makes you upload the actual materials first, then Socratically questions you toward understanding instead of spoon-feeding.
skills.desc_en: 大學備考蘇格拉底式學習助手，專為應對"面向課本和PPT考試"設計。當用戶說"幫我複習"、"準備考試"、"備考"、"期末複習"、"模擬學習"、"突擊複習"等時觸發。核心特點：(1)強制要求用戶上傳課本/PPT/考綱等原始材料——沒有材料就無法有效輔導；(2)使用蘇格拉底式提問法，不直接灌輸而是引導思考；(3)專注於應用型和理解型內容，而非純概念記憶；(4)模擬真實考試場景進行針對性練習；(5)分析材料識別高頻考點和重難點。適用於大學各科目期中期末考試備考、突擊複習、考前模擬。
skills.why_zh: 「沒材料就不輔導」這條硬約束很誠實：逼你對著真考綱學，而不是聽 AI 編一套。
skills.why_en: The no-materials-no-tutoring rule is honest — it forces study against the real syllabus, not a generic AI-invented one.
skills.limit_zh: 沒傳課本/PPT/考綱它就只要材料，不開講。PDF、Word 得另借 docx/pdf skill 提取。正文全中文，射程鎖在大學期中期末，腳本只有 analyze_material.py 和 generate_questions.py。
skills.limit_en: With no textbook, slides or syllabus uploaded it only asks for material and refuses to tutor. PDFs and Word files need a separate docx/pdf skill to extract. The body is all Chinese and scoped strictly to university midterms and finals.
skills.title_en: Refuses to tutor you without the actual syllabus

skills.tagline_zh: 切片工具滿地都是，但敢把未發布的素材傳上去嗎？它端側轉寫、LLM 找高光、9:16 重構、卡拉OK字幕，每條還打病毒潛力分，全程不出你的機器。

Use when the user asks to clip / cut / 切片 / 剪 a long video, podcast or stream replay into short clips, find highlights / 爆點 in a video, or transcribe a media file. Footage never leaves the machine.

skills.name: gtm-cofounder

skills.name: design-review

skills.tagline_en: Deep design review for Go codebases — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces and error handling scored, with fixes.

skills.name: kinocut

skills.why_en: The guardrails are the soul — plan-then-execute, traceable cuts, no irreversible butchery of your footage.

skills.name: trading-design

skills.tagline_en: A design system for trading software — panel layouts, data density, market color semantics and interaction rules.
skills.desc_en: Professional trading UI design system. Load when designing or implementing panels, layouts, typography, color, data display, or interactions for trading applications.
skills.why_zh: 成體系的交易 UI 資料極其罕見，做行情類產品時這塊知識很難自己攢。
skills.why_en: Trading UI is special-forces design — color semantics, millisecond density; systematic references are rare.
skills.limit_zh: 只給規則不給 token：具體顏色和像素值要你自己的設計系統補，正文沒有一行組件代碼。深色是設計靶心，淺色只是把層級反過來。硬到「圓角一律為零、彩色只准兩個」，跟通用儀表盤規範會打架。
skills.limit_en: Rules only, no tokens — exact colors and pixel values stay in your own design system, and no component code ships. Dark is the target; light is a reversed adaptation. Hard rules: zero border radius everywhere, exactly two chromatic hues.
skills.title_en: Design rules for screens where color means money

skills.name: agent-skills
skills.title_zh: Addy 的工程技能箱
skills.tagline_zh: Chrome 團隊 Addy Osmani 的私藏工具箱一次帶走：API 設計、DevTools 排查、CI/CD 避坑，件件短而鋒利。
skills.tagline_en: Addy Osmani's (Chrome team) personal toolbox in one grab — API design, DevTools debugging and CI/CD, each piece short and sharp.
skills.desc_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents by Addy Osmani
skills.why_zh: 作者是寫過多本前端名著的谷歌工程負責人，工程口味極正：每件都短、準、能落地。
skills.why_en: From the Google engineering lead behind several classic frontend books — short, sharp, immediately usable.
skills.limit_zh: 僅適用於編碼類 Agent（如 Claude Code、Cursor）。不包含 UI 設計、運維部署等非編碼域。
skills.limit_en: For coding agents only (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor). No UI/ops coverage. Skills provide checklists & flows, not auto-fixes; complex architecture.
skills.title_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

skills.name: novel-to-game
skills.title_zh: 喂進一本小說，產出的不是概念稿是真能玩的遊戲
skills.tagline_zh: 餵給它一本小說，它按原著設定拆世界觀、出美術方向、選目標引擎，直接把遊戲做出來——不是概念稿，是真的能玩。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it a novel; it extracts the world, art-directs it, and builds a genuinely playable game grounded in the source text.
skills.desc_en: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prot
skills.why_zh: 「把喜歡的小說做成能玩的遊戲」是很多人的童年夢想，這個 skill 把整條流水線打包好了，交給 Claude Code 就能開工。
skills.why_en: Turning a beloved book into a playable game is a childhood dream for a lot of people — this packages the whole pipeline so Claude Code can just get to work.
skills.limit_zh: 要 novel-game-analyze、game-concept、game-qa 一整家子都在才轉得動。默認做的是驗證切片不是全本遊戲；完成只認啟動、渲染、輸入、核心循環、一次結果、重開六項。
skills.limit_en: Only turns if the whole family is installed — novel-game-analyze, game-concept, game-build, game-qa. Default scope is a verification slice, not a full game, and it says outright that fun and balance are not things it can prove.
skills.title_en: Turns a novel you love into a playable game

skills.name: huashu-design
skills.title_zh: HTML 原型先出三稿再動手的設計師
skills.tagline_zh: 花叔出品：一句需求，產出高保真 HTML 原型、幻燈片和動畫，附贈 20 條他自己的設計哲學，審美立場直接寫進輸出。
skills.tagline_en: From Huashu: one request in, hi-fi HTML prototypes, slides and motion out — shipped with his 20 design principles baked into every output.
skills.desc_en: 花叔Design——用HTML做高保真原型、幻燈片、動畫、可視化與專家評審。任何新設計100%先出三個方向初稿給用戶選（指定風格/品牌也不豁免），選定後才執行。觸發詞：做原型、PPT、幻燈片、動畫、設計風格、評審、做個HTML頁面、UI mockup、導出MP4/GIF、做個好看的。生產級Web App/需後端的系統不適用。
skills.why_zh: 中文社區口碑最好的設計 skill：不只給樣式，還給審美立場——附贈的 20 條設計哲學正是大多數 AI 頁面缺的東西。
skills.why_en: The Chinese community's best-loved design skill — it ships a point of view (20 design principles), not just styles.
skills.limit_zh: 任何新設計都是先出三版真初稿、然後停下等你選，無人值守的會話跑不完。生產級 Web App、SEO 站、要後端的系統作者寫明不接。動畫產出默認壓上 Created by Huashu-Design 水印。
skills.limit_en: Every new design starts with three real drafts and then stops for your pick — it won't self-select even in unattended sessions. Production web apps, SEO sites and backend systems are out of scope. Animations carry a Huashu-Design watermark.
skills.cover_note: 09-03 對賬：文件不存在，和記錄不符且拿不回真圖，下卡
skills.title_en: HTML prototyping that shows 3 directions first

skills.name: muyang-dark-fashion
skills.title_zh: 牧羊暗黑時裝，一款一裝
skills.tagline_zh: 黑紅冷光鎖死，不跟詩意水墨混裝
skills.tagline_en: Want dark red, Korean, or cold-glow style without prompt wrestling? It only asks your subject, drops it into a.
skills.desc_en: 風格包含：暗調黑紅插畫、暗黑韓系插畫、暗黑冷光插畫。用於收集用戶指定的主體和具體風格，將主體原樣填入對應固定配方並直接生成圖片；不得展示提示詞、擴寫、改寫或混合光色。
skills.why_zh: 同一作者詩意水墨之外的一款。主體原樣填進暗黑時裝配方，不許改光色。
skills.why_en: Locks style into three rigid recipes, preventing model drift; subject stays untouched, so your specified content never gets.
skills.limit_zh: 不是插畫工具箱。要東方詩意，去裝那一件。
skills.limit_en: Only handles 3 dark styles; others ignored. Outputs image only, never prompts. Vague subjects (e.g., 'draw anything') stall it since it needs exact.
skills.title_en: Turn photos into dark-style illustrations with 3 fixed.

skills.name: story-deslop
skills.title_zh: 刪掉「她眸色一暗」的網文去AI味改稿器
skills.tagline_zh: 檢測並清除網文裡的 AI 寫作痕跡：模板化開頭、翻譯腔、排比堆砌，讓文字迴歸人寫的自然感。
skills.tagline_en: Detects and scrubs AI fingerprints from web fiction — template openings, stilted phrasing, parallelism piles — back to human.
skills.desc_en: 網文去AI味。檢測並清除文本中的AI寫作痕跡，讓文字迴歸自然、非模板化。觸發方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「這篇太AI了」「網文去AI味」。
skills.why_zh: 網文讀者對 AI 味極其敏感，平臺也在查；這是全家桶裡最保命的一件。
skills.why_en: Web-fiction readers (and platforms) smell AI instantly; this is the pack's survival tool.
skills.limit_zh: 只對中文網文有用，禁用詞表和腳本都是照網文口味調的。文件模式要 Node 跑 check-ai-patterns.js 等三個腳本，沒有就只剩肉眼判斷。默認把正文裡的 …… 和 —— 全清掉，不吃這套排版口味的別裝。
skills.limit_en: Chinese web-novel prose only — the banned-word list and scripts are tuned for it. File mode needs Node for check-ai-patterns.js and two sibling scripts. By default it strips ellipses and em dashes, and promises no detector score.
skills.title_en: Strip AI clichés from web fiction

skills.name: glitch-pixel-collage
skills.title_zh: 故障像素拼貼
skills.tagline_zh: 上傳人像或街景，立刻得到賽博故障感拼貼。不是濾鏡，是像素級打亂重組，每張輸出都獨一無二。
skills.tagline_en: Upload a portrait or street shot, get a cyber-glitch collage instantly. Not a filter—pixel-level shuffling makes.
skills.desc_en: Wibi Style 官方視覺風格。把用戶上傳的一張照片轉換成亂碼像素拼貼風格。適用於用戶要求亂碼像素拼貼、上傳照片換風格，或明確調用 $glitch-pixel-collage 時。
skills.why_zh: 同一作者的另一件單風格。拼貼和故障是兩套語法，不混裝。
skills.why_en: No filter—it reorders pixel blocks and injects code-like noise, keeping the original silhouette while destroying the surface.
skills.limit_zh: 清晰度讓路給故障。要乾淨印刷稿，別裝這件。
skills.limit_en: Single static photo only; no video/GIF. Output is static PNG. Requires ImageMagick & Python3. Faces may be too distorted for recognizable portraits.
skills.title_en: Turn one photo into a glitch-pixel collage

skills.name: ponytail
skills.title_zh: 先問「這真的需要做嗎」，能不寫的代碼一行不寫
skills.tagline_zh: 請一位「躺平但靠譜」的資深工程師進駐：話少、主意正、先問清楚再動手，能不寫的代碼一行都不會寫。
skills.tagline_en: An unbothered senior engineer moves in — few words, strong opinions, asks before acting, and writes not one line of code that needn't exist.
skills.desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode for any coding task (write, refactor, fix, review): YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Not for non-coding requests.
skills.why_zh: 反內捲的工程精髓——它總在問「這真的需要做嗎」，治過度設計比寫代碼更省錢。
skills.why_en: Its favorite question is "do we even need this?" — killing overengineering saves more than writing code.
skills.limit_zh: 它是常駐人格：ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE，要說 stop ponytail 才關。作者寫明非編碼請求不適用，而且只管「建什麼」不管「怎麼說話」，文風得另配 Caveman。
skills.limit_en: A persistent persona: ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE until you say "stop ponytail" or "normal mode". The author states it is not for non-coding requests, and it governs what you build, not how you talk - prose style needs a separate skill (Caveman).
skills.title_en: A senior engineer who talks you out of code

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.title_zh: 截圖變代碼時先對齊設計意圖，不做像素級復刻
skills.tagline_zh: 丟一張截圖，還原成有品味的代碼而不是像素堆：它優先還原設計意圖和層級關係，不死磕像素級復刻。
skills.tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get tasteful code back — it recovers design intent and hierarchy first instead of grinding for pixel parity.
skills.desc_en: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping o
skills.why_zh: 難點在還原「設計意圖」而非像素級復刻，它在這個取捨上做得很聰明。
skills.why_en: Recovers design intent rather than chasing pixel parity — the smart trade-off.
skills.limit_zh: 正文講的是它自己先生成設計圖再照著實現，通篇沒寫怎麼讀你手上的截圖。環境必須能生圖，Codex 裡每段單獨出一張大圖，八段落地頁就是八張圖的錢。範圍只到落地頁、hero、作品集這類營銷頁。
skills.limit_en: It generates its own design image and then implements that — nowhere does it describe reading a screenshot you already have. Needs image generation available; in Codex that means one large image per section, so an eight-section page costs eight images. Scope stops at landing, marketing and portfolio pages.
skills.title_en: Screenshot to code that chases intent, not pixels

skills.name: understand-figma
skills.title_zh: 接上 Figma API，把設計稿拆成一張設計系統知識圖譜
skills.tagline_zh: 接上 Figma API，把設計稿拆成頁面、組件、變體、設計令牌的知識圖譜，設計系統長什麼樣一張圖看明白。
skills.tagline_en: Hooks the Figma REST API and maps a file into pages, components, variants and tokens — the whole design system legible in one graph.
skills.desc_en: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.
skills.why_zh: 設計交接的痛點被它按住了：設計系統長什麼樣，一張圖譜看明白。
skills.why_en: Design handoff, solved visually — the whole system in one graph.
skills.limit_zh: 要自備 FIGMA_TOKEN，還要 Node ≥22、pnpm ≥10 並先 build 出 core 才跑得動。正文明說它會外連 api.figma.com，不像 /understand 那樣離線。分析批次失敗只記警告不重試。
skills.limit_en: You supply your own FIGMA_TOKEN, plus Node >= 22, pnpm >= 10 and a core build before it runs. The text states it calls out to api.figma.com and is not offline like /understand. Failed analysis batches are logged as warnings, not retried.
skills.title_en: Maps a Figma file into one design-system graph

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 13 個子代理組隊做研究，互相審稿和事實核查
skills.tagline_zh: 13 個子代理組隊做嚴肅研究：綜述、快報、審稿、事實核查、三路文獻掃描，8 種模式按需開團。
skills.tagline_en: A 13-agent research team with 8 modes — full studies, quick briefs, paper review, fact-checks and three-way literature scans on demand.
skills.desc_en: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 8 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, three-way literature scan, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, sourc
skills.why_zh: 這是「把 deep research 開源自建」的認真嘗試，分工和交叉驗證的設計相當講究。
skills.why_en: A serious open-source take on deep research — the division of labor and cross-checks are well designed.

install.note_zh: 兩件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 裡都叫 deep-research —— 生態是扁平命名空間，同名就會互相靜默覆蓋。這裡加了作者前綴消歧，跟作者倉庫裡的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 單件裝不起來：路由靠倉庫根的 .claude/CLAUDE.md 和 shared/，默認由 academic-pipeline 調度。改稿最多兩輪，剩下的問題直接寫進「已知侷限」交差。
skills.limit_en: Not installable alone: routing depends on the repo-root .claude/CLAUDE.md and shared/, and the default mode is dispatched by academic-pipeline. Revision is capped at two loops; what remains is filed under "acknowledged limitations".
skills.title_en: Thirteen research agents that cross-check each other

skills.name: claude-ai-music-skills
skills.title_zh: 給 Suno 配上歌詞工作流和混音清單，從玩票做到成品
skills.tagline_zh: 人機協作的 Suno 音樂生產流：風格模板、歌詞工作流、混音清單，把「玩 Suno」升級成「做音樂」。
skills.tagline_en: A human-plus-AI Suno production line — style templates, lyric workflows and mix checklists; from toying to producing.
skills.desc_en: Human + AI music production workflow for Suno - skills, templates, and tools
skills.why_zh: Suno 玩家眾多但成品率低，這套流程補的正是「從段子到作品」的那段路。
skills.why_en: Plenty of Suno players, few finished tracks — this pack covers exactly that gap.

install.note: clone 下來，挑你要的那件複製進 ~/.claude/skills/。這是一個合集，沒有「裝它」這個動作。

skills.limit_zh: 歌不是它生成的：音頻得你自己去 Suno 出、把 stems 拿回來，它管概念、歌詞、Suno 提示詞、母帶和發行。52 件裡 8 件是插件自用件（about/help/setup/test 等），真能用的 44 件。
skills.limit_en: It does not make the audio — you generate on Suno and bring the stems back; it covers concept, lyrics, Suno prompts, mastering and release prep. Of its 52 skills, 8 are plugin housekeeping (about/help/setup/test/health-check); 44 are actually usable.
skills.title_en: Turns Suno noodling into finished, mixed tracks
skills.limit_brief_zh: 歌不是它生成的，音頻要你去 Suno 出。
skills.limit_brief_en: It does not make the audio; you generate that on Suno.

skills.name: hue
skills.title_zh: 學一次你的品牌，之後 agent 做的每個界面都照著來
skills.tagline_zh: 學習任何品牌並輸出完整設計系統：裝一次，之後 agent 做的每個界面都長在你的品牌基因上。
skills.tagline_en: Learns any brand and emits a full design system — install once, and every UI your agent builds matches your identity.
skills.desc_en: Meta-skill that generates new design language skills. Works on Claude Code and Codex. Use when the user says 'create a design skill', 'generate design language', 'new design system skill', 'design skill inspired by X', 'design skill from this screenshot', '/hue', or 'use hue'. Also triggers for 'remix my design skill' or 'make my skill more X'.
skills.why_zh: 「品牌一致性」從人肉盯改變成系統保證，小團隊也能有大廠級的視覺紀律。
skills.why_en: Brand consistency goes from manual policing to systemic guarantee — big-co discipline for small teams.
skills.limit_zh: 它產的是一件新 skill，不是界面；而且生成的 description 硬寫 NEVER trigger automatically，之後每次都得點名叫它。沒接 Chrome DevTools MCP 就降級取色並自報低可信。
skills.limit_en: It outputs a new skill, not a UI - and the generated description must contain "NEVER trigger automatically", so you invoke it by name every time. Without Chrome DevTools MCP it falls back to WebFetch and flags reduced confidence.
skills.title_en: Install your brand once, every screen obeys

skills.name: archify
skills.title_zh: 畫出來的架構圖要和代碼對得上，導出自帶動效的 HTML
skills.tagline_zh: 產出可驗證的架構、時序、數據流、生命週期圖：自包含 HTML 自帶動效，導出清晰銳利可直接交付。
skills.tagline_en: Validated architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML with motion, crisp exports.
skills.desc_en: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. U
skills.why_zh: 「可驗證」是關鍵詞：圖和描述對得上號，不是好看但騙人的裝飾畫。
skills.why_en: "Verifiable" is the keyword — diagrams that match reality, not pretty fiction.
skills.limit_zh: 靠 node bin/archify.mjs 出圖；收尾的 visual-check 要本機有 Chrome，沒有就退出碼 2 給張 skipped 收據。只做架構、流程、時序、數據流、生命週期五類，主節點建議不超過 12 個。
skills.limit_en: Everything runs through node bin/archify.mjs, and the closing visual-check needs local Chrome — without it you get exit code 2 and a skipped receipt. Five diagram types only, ~12 primary nodes max, and the layout targets desktop widths.
skills.title_en: Architecture diagrams that get checked against the code

skills.name: citation-management
skills.title_zh: 每條引用都回數據庫核驗，揪出 AI 編造的參考文獻
skills.tagline_zh: 檢索 OpenAlex、PubMed、Google Scholar，抽取準確元數據、校驗引用、格式化文獻——引用錯誤終結者。
skills.tagline_en: Searches OpenAlex, PubMed and Scholar, extracts clean metadata, validates and formats citations — the reference-error killer.
skills.desc_en: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.
skills.why_zh: AI 編造引用是學術圈最怕的事，它反其道而行：每條引用都可驗證、有出處。
skills.why_en: Fabricated citations are academia's nightmare; this does the opposite — every reference verifiable.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python 3.9+ 和 requests，還要連得上 openalex、crossref、pubmed。Google Scholar 沒有 API，靠 scholarly 爬，每條歇 2 到 5 秒還常被封，作者自己說只能當補充。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python 3.9+ with requests plus network access to openalex, crossref and pubmed. Google Scholar has no API: scholarly scrapes it, sleeps 2-5s per result and is blocked often, so the skill itself calls it a supplement.
skills.title_en: Kills the fabricated citation before your reviewer finds it

skills.name: humanizer
skills.title_zh: 照一份句式級的臭味清單刪掉「值得注意的是」
skills.tagline_zh: 一鍵去 AI 味：刪掉「值得注意的是」、排比腔和空洞總結——那份「AI 寫作臭味清單」具體到了句式級別。
skills.tagline_en: Strip the AI-isms — "it's worth noting", triple parallelism and hollow wrap-ups gone; the smell-list is specific down to sentence patterns.
skills.desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive voice, negative
skills.why_zh: 它列的「AI 寫作臭味清單」具體到句式級別，反過來讀就是一堂寫作課。
skills.why_en: Its catalog of AI writing smells is specific down to the sentence pattern — read it backwards and it's a writing course.
skills.limit_zh: 35 條特徵和全部例句都來自英文維基的 Signs of AI writing，破折號、彎引號、標題大小寫那幾條挪到中文基本落空。文件模式會直接把原文件改寫成最終稿。
skills.limit_en: All 35 patterns and every example come from English Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing"; the em-dash, curly-quote and title-case rules do not carry over to Chinese. In file mode it rewrites your file in place, leaving only the final version.
skills.title_en: Deletes every "it's worth noting" you wrote
skills.cover_note: 09-03 對賬：文件不存在，和記錄不符且拿不回真圖，下卡

skills.name: book-to-skill
skills.title_zh: 把 PDF 和 EPUB 拆成能裝進 Agent 的
skills.tagline_zh: 把一本書（PDF/EPUB/DOCX 都行）拆成框架、模型、原則，裝進 agent 當技能。
skills.tagline_en: Turns a book (PDF/EPUB/DOCX…) into frameworks and principles your agent can use.
skills.desc_en: Converts books and documents (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, RTF, MOBI/AZW with Calibre) into structured agent skills, extracting frameworks, mental models, principles, techniques, and anti-patterns. Use when the user wants to study a document through GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code, apply an author's frameworks while working, or build a reusable knowledge base from a file.
skills.why_zh: 「書讀完就忘」的解法：知識不進腦子沒關係，進 agent 也行——這個立意本身就值一顆星。
skills.why_en: If the book won't stay in your head, put it in your agent — the premise alone earns a star.
skills.limit_zh: MOBI/AZW 要先裝 Calibre，技術書走 Docling 每頁約 1.5 秒，EPUB 裡的插圖直接丟掉。兩百頁的書約 7.5 萬 token，錢按你自己的模型價算。第三方版權書生成的技能只准建私有倉庫。
skills.limit_en: Runs scripts/extract.py under Python; MOBI/AZW need Calibre, technical mode uses Docling at ~1.5s a page, EPUB images are dropped. A 200-page book is ~75k tokens at your own model's rates. Copyrighted sources: private repo only.
skills.title_en: Turn PDFs & EPUBs into agent-ready skill packs

skills.name: planning-with-files
skills.title_zh: 任務拆解寫到磁盤，/clear 後自動續上進度
skills.tagline_zh: 把計劃寫成 Markdown 文件常駐磁盤：崩潰、/clear、上下文壓縮都不丟進度，隨時從斷點接著施工。
skills.tagline_en: Plans live as Markdown on disk — surviving crashes, /clear and compaction; work resumes from the exact checkpoint every time.
skills.desc_en: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
skills.why_zh: 長任務的命根子是「狀態不丟」，它用最樸素的文件方案解決，比花哨的記憶系統皮實。
skills.why_en: Long tasks live or die on durable state; plain files beat fancy memory systems for robustness.
skills.limit_zh: 裝法決定功能：npx skills add 裝的沒有 /plan-goal 和 /plan-loop。「沒做完不許停」的門也只在 Claude Code、Codex CLI 真攔得住，OpenCode、Gemini CLI 只彈提示。
skills.limit_en: The install route decides what you get: `npx skills add` ships no /plan-goal or /plan-loop; only the plugin route does. The completion gate hard-blocks on Claude Code, Codex CLI and Continue.dev; OpenCode and Gemini CLI just get a notice.
skills.title_en: File-based task planning that survives /clear

skills.name: obsidian-second-brain
skills.title_zh: 讓新資料改寫舊筆記，而不是在 Obsidian 裡越堆越多
skills.tagline_zh: 把 Obsidian 庫運營成會自我改寫的第二大腦：新資料改寫舊頁面而不是堆新筆記，越用越乾淨。
skills.tagline_en: Runs your Obsidian vault as a self-rewriting second brain — new sources revise existing pages instead of piling notes.
skills.desc_en: Operate any Obsidian vault as a living, self-rewriting second brain (an evolution of Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: sources rewrite existing pages, contradictions reconcile automatically, scheduled agents maintain the vault while you sleep). Use this skill whenever the user asks Claude to read, write, update, search, or manage their Obsidian vault - including saving notes from conversation, creating
skills.why_zh: 「改寫而非堆積」師承 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 思路，直擊筆記軟件越用越亂的死穴。
skills.why_en: Rewrite-don't-accumulate, à la Karpathy's LLM Wiki — aimed at the exact reason vaults rot.
skills.limit_zh: 腳本層要 Python 3.10+ 和 uv，/x-read、/x-pulse 必須自備 xAI Grok key。正文自認在 1000+ 筆記庫首跑 recall@10 是 0%——raw/ 與 log.md 會壓垮詞頻排序。
skills.limit_en: The script layer needs Python 3.10+ with uv, and /x-read and /x-pulse require your own xAI Grok key. The text reports a first retrieval run on a 1,000+ note vault scoring 0% recall@10 - long raw/ transcripts and log.md dominate ranking.
skills.title_en: Notes that rewrite themselves instead of piling up

skills.name: agent-skill-creator
skills.title_zh: 把口頭流程變成能跑的跨平臺技能，三步內交付
skills.tagline_zh: 把任何工作流寫成一次、裝到 17 個平臺：Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 全兼容的 skill 鑄造機。
skills.tagline_en: Write a workflow once, install it on 17 platforms — a skill foundry compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more.
skills.desc_en: Create cross-platform agent skills from workflow descriptions. Activates when users ask to create an agent, automate a repetitive workflow, create a custom skill, or need advanced agent creation. Triggers on phrases like create agent for, automate workflow, create skill for, every day I have to, daily I need to, turn process into agent, need to automate, create a cross-platform skill, validate thi
skills.why_zh: 跨平臺是 skill 生態的下一站。
skills.why_en: Cross-platform is the ecosystem's next stop; this ships write-once-run-anywhere early.
skills.limit_zh: 17 個平臺裡只有 12 個原樣能裝，Cursor、Windsurf 等 4 個要轉格式，Zed、Aider 等 4 個得你手抄進配置。校驗和安全掃描都是 python3 腳本，過了它會直接裝進你的配置目錄。
skills.limit_en: Of 17 platforms only 12 install SKILL.md as-is; 4 (Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Junie) are auto-rewritten and 4 (Zed, Augment, Aider, Continue) need manual copying. Validation and security scan are python3 scripts; it auto-installs on pass.
skills.title_en: Turn spoken workflows into installable cross-platform.

skills.name: social-post
skills.title_zh: 學你的語氣排好 14 天日曆，再替你按下發布鍵
skills.tagline_zh: 學你的 Facebook 語氣，按 14 天內容日曆自動寫併發到 FB/IG/Threads/X——實測單帖 8 萬觸達。
skills.tagline_en: Learns your Facebook voice, then writes and posts to FB, IG, Threads and X on a 14-day calendar — 80K-reach validated.
skills.desc_en: 學使用者的 Facebook 個人貼文語氣，依 14 天內容策略日曆，自動產出並發布到 FB / Instagram / Threads / X。使用時機：使用者說「發文」、「幫我寫一篇貼文」、「用我的風格發」、「今天發一篇」、「PO 一下」、「學我的語氣」、「分析我的貼文風格」、「重新規劃內容」、「排貼文」、「查流量」、「review」時一律觸發；即使只說「發一篇」、「PO 文」、「PO 個廢文」也要觸發。
skills.why_zh: 「學語氣 + 排日曆 + 真發布」三步閉環，是個人 IP 運營少見的全自動解。
skills.why_en: Voice-learning, calendaring and actual posting in one loop — rare full automation for personal brands.
skills.limit_zh: 正文是繁體。真發帖要 chrome:control-chrome 和已登錄的瀏覽器，每篇都得你當場確認，沒有 IG 圖片素材它就停。成效全落本地 data/*.jsonl，換臺機器歸零。
skills.limit_en: Traditional Chinese. Publishing needs `chrome:control-chrome` and an already-signed-in browser, with in-session confirmation per post; no IG image and it stops. Performance data lives in local data/*.jsonl, so a new machine starts empty.
skills.title_en: Learns your voice, then actually hits post

skills.name: vibe-check
skills.title_zh: 帶純新手把模糊點子變成計劃，順手教會他用 GitHub
skills.tagline_zh: 由 12 年產品老兵帶路：把純新手的模糊點子變成能開工的計劃，邊建邊教 GitHub 和乾淨代碼習慣。
skills.tagline_en: A 12-year PM walks a total beginner from vague idea to buildable plan, teaching GitHub basics and clean habits along the way.
skills.desc_en: Turn a complete beginner's app idea into a buildable plan, then keep them oriented while they build. Use it whenever someone who has never coded wants to build or "vibe code" an app, has an idea but no idea where to start, or wants it turned into a plan, MVP scope, tech stack, user flows, or blueprint. It has three on-ramps: the full journey, a validate-only pass ("is my idea worth building", "rea
skills.why_zh: vibe coding 時代最缺的是「有人扶一把」，這件就是那隻手，姿勢還很專業。
skills.why_en: The vibe-coding era's missing ingredient is a steady hand; this is that hand, professionally trained.
skills.limit_zh: 調研這步靠抓 Reddit 和 G2 評論，抓不動就退成把網址和搜索詞交給你自己去粘。作圖引擎要瀏覽器和臨時文件，跑不起來退回 mermaid。正文全英文，且明說不管有經驗開發者的調試、重構和 CI/CD。
skills.limit_en: Discovery depends on fetching Reddit and review sites; when the environment blocks that, it hands you the sites and search phrases to paste yourself. The diagram engine needs a browser and temp files or falls back to mermaid. English only.
skills.title_en: A veteran PM walks your first build

skills.name: scene-distillation-zine-v1-3
skills.title_zh: 一張照片蒸餾成一本敢留白的迷你zine
skills.tagline_zh: 可翻的薄刊物，不是一張海報
skills.tagline_en: Your photo stays a photo; this turns it into a poster of pure illustration, metaphor, negative space, and.
skills.desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into an expressive minimal zine poster made only from original source-derived illustration, an artistic proposition, emotional tension, visual metaphor, spacious negative space, art-directed high-chroma color, and unconstrained authorial typography. Let wording, language, amount, placement, type voices, scale, direction, legibility, and image interaction follow expr
skills.why_zh: 一場戲壓成能翻的幾頁：順序、留白、紙感都按刊物走。
skills.why_en: No templates: it mines your image for emotional tension and visual metaphor, then lets type scale, weight, and placement follow.
skills.limit_zh: 頁少。要長篇畫冊、要分鏡腳本，裝不下。
skills.limit_en: Single photo in, no collages; outputs a concept poster, not print-ready files; high-chroma art direction may clash with corporate branding; fonts.
skills.title_en: Distill one photo into a bold, airy mini zine

skills.name: threejs-skills
skills.title_zh: 不寫一行渲染代碼，Three.js 場景從口述到可交
skills.tagline_zh: 寫 3D 交互最煩相機、燈光、後期這些樣板。這套包把十個高頻場景直接拆成可調用模塊，粘貼即跑，不用從零搭。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of boilerplate camera, lights, and postprocessing? These 10 modules drop into any Three.js scene—paste and.
skills.desc_en: A pack of 10 skills.
skills.why_zh: 每個 skill 只做一件事，但內部把 renderer、composer、controls 的聯動都。
skills.why_en: Each skill does one thing, but wires renderer, composer, and controls together—saves you at least two hours of doc-diving per.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆蓋 Three.js 官方示例風格的基礎場景，不含 GLTF 加載、物理引擎或自定義 shader 調試。
skills.limit_en: Covers only basic Three.js example-style scenes; no GLTF loading, physics, or custom shader debugging. Modules don't share state—complex projects.

install.note: clone 下來，挑你要的那件複製進 ~/.claude/skills/。這是一個合集，沒有「裝它」這個動作。

skills.title_en: Describe a 3D scene, get a working Three.js sketch

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.title_zh: 懷疑驅動開發
skills.tagline_zh: 每個非平凡決策都要過一遍「新上下文對抗審查」：換一個乾淨腦子來挑刺攻擊，站得住的方案才算數。
skills.tagline_en: Every non-trivial decision faces a fresh-context adversarial review — a clean mind attacks it; only survivors stand.
skills.desc_en: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.
skills.why_zh: 對抗自己確認偏誤的聰明設計：正確性優先的場景裡，這一步價值極高。
skills.why_en: A clever weapon against your own confirmation bias — invaluable when correctness beats speed.
skills.limit_zh: 只對非平凡決策生效，瑣碎改動會拖慢節奏；需要你主動調用，不會自動觸發；評審產出的是質疑清單，不負責修復或驗證。
skills.limit_en: Only for non-trivial decisions; trivial edits slow down. Manual invocation only. Outputs a challenge list, not fixes or verification—pair with tests.
skills.title_en: Adversarial fresh-context review before every key decision

skills.name: understand-chat
skills.title_zh: 按調用結構而不是搜字符串，回答改這裡會牽動誰
skills.tagline_zh: 對著代碼庫的知識圖譜直接提問：這段邏輯在哪、誰調用誰、改這裡會牽動什麼——按結構找答案，不是搜字符串。
skills.tagline_en: Ask the codebase graph directly — where's this logic, who calls whom, what breaks if I touch this; answers by structure, not grep.
skills.desc_en: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph
skills.why_zh: 比全文搜索聰明一檔——它按結構找答案，不是按字符串。
skills.why_en: A tier above grep: answers by structure, not string match.
skills.limit_zh: 它只讀 .ua/knowledge-graph.json，那張圖得先跑 /understand 生成，沒有就只能勸你去跑。圖按 git commit 記時。
skills.limit_en: It only reads .ua/knowledge-graph.json, which the sibling /understand skill must build first - without it, all it can do is tell you to run that. The graph is stamped with a git commit, so after code edits it only warns of staleness.
skills.title_en: Ask what breaks if you touch this function

skills.name: interview-me
skills.title_zh: 逼問需求
skills.tagline_zh: 一次只問一個問題，把你「以為想要的」問成「真正想要的」，問到約 95% 確信才允許動手開工。
skills.tagline_en: One question at a time until ~95% confidence — extracting what you actually want, not what you think you should want.
skills.desc_en: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yours
skills.why_zh: 需求錯了後面全白乾，這個「先逼問再動手」的紀律省下的是整個項目的返工。
skills.why_en: Wrong requirements waste everything downstream; interrogation-first saves the whole project's rework.
skills.limit_zh: 只適用於需求模糊、需澄清意圖的場景。若需求已明確（如“給60歲父母做語音提醒”），它仍會盤問，浪費你時間。
skills.limit_en: Only for vague asks needing intent clarification. If your need is already clear (e.g., "voice reminders for 60-year-old parents"), it still.
skills.title_en: Interview to extract what you truly want, not what you.
